"""
پنل ادمین — کنترل تنظیمات مطالعه (با رمز)
"""
from nicegui import ui, app

from web_app.config import PAGE_CSS
from web_app.admin_config import (
    load_admin_config,
    save_admin_config,
    get_admin_password,
)


@ui.page('/admin')
def admin_page():
    ui.query('body').style(PAGE_CSS)
    state = {"authenticated": False}

    container = ui.column().classes(
        'w-full max-w-3xl mx-auto p-8 gap-4'
    )

    def _render_login():
        container.clear()
        with container:
            ui.label("🔒 پنل ادمین").classes(
                'text-3xl font-bold text-cyan-400 '
                'text-center w-full mt-16'
            )
            ui.label(
                "برای دسترسی، رمز عبور را وارد کنید."
            ).classes(
                'text-sm text-gray-400 text-center w-full mb-4'
            )
            pwd = ui.input(
                placeholder="رمز عبور",
                password=True,
                password_toggle_button=True,
            ).classes('w-full text-lg p-3')

            def _login():
                if pwd.value == get_admin_password():
                    state["authenticated"] = True
                    _render_panel()
                else:
                    ui.notify(
                        "رمز عبور نادرست است",
                        type='negative', position='top',
                    )

            ui.button(
                "ورود", on_click=_login,
            ).classes(
                'w-full py-3 text-lg font-bold '
                'bg-cyan-600 hover:bg-cyan-500'
            )
            pwd.on('keydown.enter', _login)

    def _render_panel():
        container.clear()
        with container:
            # هدر
            with ui.row().classes(
                'w-full items-center justify-between'
            ):
                ui.label("⚙️ پنل کنترل مطالعه").classes(
                    'text-2xl font-bold text-cyan-400'
                )
                ui.button(
                    "🚪 خروج", on_click=_render_login,
                ).classes(
                    'bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-500 text-sm'
                )

            cfg = load_admin_config()

            # ============ بخش ۱: فازها ============
            with ui.card().classes(
                'w-full bg-slate-800 border border-cyan-400 p-4'
            ):
                ui.label("📅 فازها (روزهای اصلی)").classes(
                    'text-lg font-bold text-cyan-300 mb-3'
                )
                phase_boxes = {}
                phase_labels = {
                    "phase1": "روز اول — سکوت",
                    "phase2": "روز دوم — سایه‌ها",
                    "phase3": "روز سوم — معمای داده‌ها",
                    "phase4": "روز چهارم — شورا",
                }
                for key, label in phase_labels.items():
                    phase_boxes[key] = ui.checkbox(
                        label,
                        value=cfg["phases"].get(key, True),
                    ).classes('text-base text-white')

            # ============ بخش ۲: بخش‌های روایی ============
            with ui.card().classes(
                'w-full bg-slate-800 border border-orange-400 p-4'
            ):
                ui.label("🎬 بخش‌های روایی").classes(
                    'text-lg font-bold text-orange-300 mb-3'
                )
                section_boxes = {}
                section_labels = {
                    "prologue": "پرولوگ در مقدمه",
                    "interludes": "میان‌پرده‌ها",
                    "nights": "شب‌های ایستگاه",
                    "letter_to_self": "نامه به خود",
                    "epilogue": "پایان روایی (Epilogue)",
                }
                for key, label in section_labels.items():
                    section_boxes[key] = ui.checkbox(
                        label,
                        value=cfg["sections"].get(key, True),
                    ).classes('text-base text-white')

            # ============ بخش ۳: پرسشنامه‌ها ============
            with ui.card().classes(
                'w-full bg-slate-800 border border-purple-400 p-4'
            ):
                ui.label("📝 پرسشنامه‌ها و آزمون‌ها").classes(
                    'text-lg font-bold text-purple-300 mb-3'
                )
                q_boxes = {}
                q_labels = {
                    "hexaco": "HEXACO-24",
                    "crt": "CRT7 (تأمل شناختی)",
                    "tower_of_hanoi": "برج هانوی (تطبیقی)",
                    "sd3": "SD3 (مثلث تاریک)",
                    "sd": "SD (مطلوبیت اجتماعی)",
                    "feedback": "بازخورد پس از بازی",
                }
                for key, label in q_labels.items():
                    q_boxes[key] = ui.checkbox(
                        label,
                        value=cfg["questionnaires"].get(key, True),
                    ).classes('text-base text-white')

            # ============ بخش ۴: رمز عبور ============
            with ui.card().classes(
                'w-full bg-slate-800 border border-red-400 p-4'
            ):
                ui.label("🔐 تغییر رمز عبور").classes(
                    'text-lg font-bold text-red-300 mb-3'
                )
                new_pwd = ui.input(
                    label="رمز جدید (حداقل ۸ کاراکتر)",
                    password=True,
                    value="",
                ).classes('w-full')

            # ============ بخش ۴: مسیریابی سفارشی ============
            with ui.card().classes(
                'w-full bg-slate-800 border border-green-400 p-4'
            ):
                ui.label("🗺️ مسیریابی سفارشی (Flow)").classes(
                    'text-lg font-bold text-green-300 mb-1'
                )
                ui.label(
                    "برای تغییر ترتیب، کلید مرحله‌ی فعلی و آدرس مقصد را وارد کنید. "
                    "(مثال: phase1 -> /hexaco). اگر خالی باشد، حالت پیش‌فرض اجرا می‌شود."
                ).classes('text-xs text-gray-400 mb-3')
                
                routing_container = ui.column().classes('w-full gap-2')
                current_routing = cfg.get("routing", {})
                
                routing_inputs = {}
                for k, v in current_routing.items():
                    with ui.row().classes('w-full gap-2 no-wrap'):
                        ui.label(k).classes('w-1/3 text-white font-mono text-sm mt-2')
                        routing_inputs[k] = ui.input(value=v).classes('flex-1')
                
                # افزودن ردیف جدید
                with ui.row().classes('w-full gap-2 no-wrap mt-2'):
                    new_key = ui.input(placeholder="کلید (مثلا phase1)").classes('w-1/3')
                    new_val = ui.input(placeholder="مقصد (مثلا /hexaco)").classes('flex-1')
                    
                    def _add_route():
                        if new_key.value and new_val.value:
                            routing_inputs[new_key.value] = ui.input(value=new_val.value).classes('flex-1')
                            # رسم مجدد پنل
                            _render_panel()
                    
                    ui.button("+", on_click=_add_route).classes('bg-green-600')

            # ============ ذخیره ============
            def _save():
                new_cfg = load_admin_config()
                new_cfg["phases"] = {
                    k: b.value for k, b in phase_boxes.items()
                }
                new_cfg["sections"] = {
                    k: b.value for k, b in section_boxes.items()
                }
                new_cfg["questionnaires"] = {
                    k: b.value for k, b in q_boxes.items()
                }
                if new_pwd.value and len(new_pwd.value) >= 8:
                    new_cfg["admin_password"] = new_pwd.value
                save_admin_config(new_cfg)
                ui.notify(
                    "✓ تنظیمات ذخیره شد",
                    type='positive', position='top',
                )
                # ✅ ذخیره مسیریابی
                new_routing = {}
                for k, inp in routing_inputs.items():
                    if inp.value:
                        new_routing[k] = inp.value
                new_cfg["routing"] = new_routing


            def _reset_defaults():
                from web_app.admin_config import DEFAULT_CONFIG
                save_admin_config(dict(DEFAULT_CONFIG))
                ui.notify(
                    "✓ به حالت پیش‌فرض بازگشت",
                    type='positive', position='top',
                )
                _render_panel()

            with ui.row().classes('w-full gap-2 mt-4'):
                ui.button(
                    "💾 ذخیره تنظیمات", on_click=_save,
                ).classes(
                    'flex-2 py-3 text-lg font-bold '
                    'bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-500'
                )
                ui.button(
                    "↺ پیش‌فرض", on_click=_reset_defaults,
                ).classes(
                    'flex-1 py-3 bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-600'
                )

            # هشدار
            ui.label(
                "⚠️ توجه: تغییر تنظیمات روی شرکت‌کنندگان فعال اثر "
                "نمی‌گذارد؛ فقط جلسات جدید از این تنظیمات استفاده "
                "می‌کنند."
            ).classes(
                'text-xs text-yellow-300 italic w-full '
                'text-right mt-2'
            )

    _render_login()

// File: truthline_pyqt/web_app/pages/crt.py

"""صفحه‌ی CRT7"""
from nicegui import ui, app, run
from web_app.config import PAGE_CSS
from web_app.db_manager import save_crt_data, log_event_threadsafe
from web_app.data.items.crt_items import CRT_ITEMS, score_crt
from web_app.components.audio_control import setup_page_audio


@ui.page('/crt')
def crt_page():
    participant_id = app.storage.user.get('participant_id')
    session_id = app.storage.user.get('session_id')
    if not participant_id or not session_id:
        ui.navigate.to('/')
        return

    setup_page_audio(None)

    ui.query('body').style(PAGE_CSS)
    answers = {}

    with ui.column().classes('w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto p-8 gap-4'):
        with ui.row().classes('w-full justify-between items-center'):
            ui.label('CRT7 — تأمل شناختی').classes('text-2xl font-bold text-cyan-400')
            ui.label(f'کد شما: {participant_id}').classes(
                'text-sm text-gray-400 font-mono bg-slate-800 px-3 py-1 rounded'
            )

        ui.label(
            'این بخش شامل ۷ سؤال کوتاه است. لطفاً با دقت بخوانید و '
            'پاسخ خود را در کادر مقابل بنویسید.'
        ).classes(
            'text-base text-gray-300 text-center leading-relaxed '
            'p-4 bg-slate-800 rounded w-full mt-2 mb-4'
        )

        progress_label = ui.label(f'0 از {len(CRT_ITEMS)}').classes(
            'text-center text-orange-400 font-bold w-full mb-4'
        )

        def update_progress():
            progress_label.set_text(f'{len(answers)} از {len(CRT_ITEMS)}')

        def _on_crt_numeric(item_id, value):
            if value and value.strip():
                answers[item_id] = value.strip()
            else:
                answers.pop(item_id, None)
            update_progress()

        def _on_crt_choice(item_id, value):
            if value is not None:
                answers[item_id] = value
                update_progress()

        for item in CRT_ITEMS:
            with ui.card().classes('w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-600 p-4'):
                ui.label(f"{item['id']}. {item['text']}").classes(
                    'text-base text-white w-full text-right leading-relaxed mb-3'
                )
                if item['type'] == 'numeric':
                    inp = ui.input(placeholder='پاسخ عددی...').classes(
                        'w-full bg-slate-700 text-white text-lg p-3 rounded'
                    )
                    inp.on_value_change(
                        lambda e, iid=item['id'], i=inp: _on_crt_numeric(iid, i.value)
                    )
                else:
                    opts = [o[1] for o in item['options']]
                    rb = ui.radio(opts, value=None).props('inline').classes('w-full justify-center')
                    rb.on_value_change(
                        lambda e, iid=item['id'], r=rb: _on_crt_choice(iid, r.value)
                    )

        async def submit_crt():
            if len(answers) < len(CRT_ITEMS):
                ui.notify(
                    f'شما به {len(answers)} سؤال از {len(CRT_ITEMS)} '
                    f'پاسخ داده‌اید.',
                    type='warning', position='top', timeout=4000,
                )
                return
            result = score_crt(answers)
            success = await run.io_bound(
                save_crt_data,
                participant_id=participant_id,
                answers=answers,
                result=result,
            )
            if not success:
                ui.notify('خطا در ذخیره‌ی داده.', type='negative', position='top', timeout=5000)
                return
            await run.io_bound(
                log_event_threadsafe,
                participant_id=participant_id,
                session_id=session_id,
                event_type='crt_completed',
                scenario_id='crt',
                metadata={'score': result['score']},
            )
            ui.notify('✓ پاسخ‌های CRT ثبت شد.', type='positive', position='top', timeout=3000)
            # ✅ حالا به آزمون برج هانوی
            from web_app.navigation import next_after_crt
            ui.navigate.to(next_after_crt())

        ui.button('ثبت پاسخ‌ها و ادامه', on_click=submit_crt).classes(
            'w-full bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-500 text-white '
            'text-xl font-bold py-4 mt-4 rounded-lg'
        )

"""صفحه‌ی دموگرافیک"""

                age_val = int(age_input.value or 25)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):

            app.storage.user['session_id'] = session_id
            app.storage.user['demographic'] = data

                log_event_threadsafe,
                participant_id=participant_id,
                session_id=session_id,
                event_type='demographic_completed',
                scenario_id='demographic',
                metadata=data,

                type='positive', position='top',
                timeout=3000,
            )

        ui.button(
            'شروع مأموریت', on_click=submit_form,
        ).classes(
            'w-full bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-500 '
            'text-white text-xl font-bold py-4 mt-2 '
            'rounded-lg'
        )

"""
پنل توسعه‌دهنده — فقط در TEST_MODE فعال است
=============================================
امکان پرش سریع به هر بخش، بدون نیاز به تکمیل فرم‌ها.
"""
import uuid
from nicegui import ui, app
from web_app.config import (
    PAGE_CSS, TEST_MODE, TEST_PARTICIPANT_PREFIX,
)
from web_app.db_manager import get_participant, create_participant
from web_app.components.audio_control import setup_page_audio


def _get_or_create_test_participant() -> tuple[str, str] | None:
    """ایجاد یا استفاده‌ی مجدد از شرکت‌کننده‌ی تست"""
    pid = app.storage.user.get('participant_id')
    session_id = app.storage.user.get('session_id')

    if pid and pid.startswith(TEST_PARTICIPANT_PREFIX) and session_id:
        if get_participant(pid):
            return pid, session_id

    new_pid = f"{TEST_PARTICIPANT_PREFIX}{str(uuid.uuid4())[:8]}"
    new_session = str(uuid.uuid4())[:12]
    success = create_participant(
        participant_id=new_pid,
        session_id=new_session,
        demographic_data={
            'age': 25,
            'gender': 'زن',
            'education': 'کارشناسی',
            'field_of_study': 'مهندسی',
            'work_experience': 'بدون سابقه کار',
            'gaming_experience': 'متوسط',
            'technical_familiarity': 'متوسط',
            'consent': True,
        },
    )
    if not success:
        return None

    app.storage.user['participant_id'] = new_pid
    app.storage.user['session_id'] = new_session
    return new_pid, new_session


@ui.page('/dev')

    if not TEST_MODE:
        ui.navigate.to('/')
        return

        )

        ui.label('پرسشنامه‌ها:').classes(

// File: truthline_pyqt/web_app/pages/download_report.py

from nicegui import ui, app, run
from web_app.report.pdf_generator import generate_pdf_report
from web_app.config import PAGE_CSS

@ui.page('/download-report')
async def download_report_page():
    participant_id = app.storage.user.get('participant_id')
    if not participant_id:
        ui.navigate.to('/')
        return
        
    ui.query('body').style(PAGE_CSS)
    with ui.column().classes('w-full items-center justify-center mt-20'):
        ui.label("در حال ساخت گزارش...").classes('text-xl text-cyan-400')
        ui.spinner(size='lg', color='cyan')
        
        try:
            path = await run.io_bound(generate_pdf_report, participant_id)
            
            # ✅ بررسی اینکه خروجی None نباشد
            if path:
                ui.notify("✓ گزارش آماده شد.", type='positive')
                ui.download(path, filename=f"Truthline_Report_{participant_id}.pdf")
            else:
                ui.notify("خطا در تولید فایل گزارش.", type='negative')
                
        except Exception as e:
            ui.notify(f"خطا در تولید گزارش: {e}", type='negative')

// File: truthline_pyqt/web_app/pages/feedback.py

"""صفحه‌ی بازخورد پس از بازی"""
from nicegui import ui, app, run
from web_app.config import PAGE_CSS
from web_app.db_manager import save_feedback_data, log_event_threadsafe
from web_app.data.items.postgame_feedback_items import (
    FEEDBACK_ITEMS, FEEDBACK_OPEN_QUESTIONS,
    FEEDBACK_DEMOGRAPHIC_ITEMS, compute_feedback_scores,
)
from web_app.components.audio_control import setup_page_audio


@ui.page('/feedback')
def feedback_page():
    participant_id = app.storage.user.get('participant_id')
    session_id = app.storage.user.get('session_id')
    if not participant_id or not session_id:
        ui.navigate.to('/')
        return

    setup_page_audio(None)

    ui.query('body').style(PAGE_CSS)
    close_answers = {}
    open_answers = {}
    demo_answers = {}

    with ui.column().classes('w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto p-8 gap-4'):
        with ui.row().classes('w-full justify-between items-center'):
            ui.label('بازخورد پس از بازی').classes('text-2xl font-bold text-cyan-400')
            ui.label(f'کد شما: {participant_id}').classes(
                'text-sm text-gray-400 font-mono bg-slate-800 px-3 py-1 rounded'
            )

        ui.label(
            'این بخش، بازخورد شما را درباره‌ی تجربه‌ی بازی جمع‌آوری '
            'می‌کند. پاسخ‌های شما به بهبود نسخه‌های بعدی کمک می‌کند.'
        ).classes(
            'text-base text-gray-300 text-center leading-relaxed '
            'p-4 bg-slate-800 rounded w-full mt-2 mb-4'
        )

        progress_label = ui.label(f'0 از {len(FEEDBACK_ITEMS)}').classes(
            'text-center text-orange-400 font-bold w-full mb-4'
        )

        def update_progress():
            progress_label.set_text(f'{len(close_answers)} از {len(FEEDBACK_ITEMS)}')

        def _on_feedback_radio(item_id, value):
            if value is not None:
                close_answers[item_id] = value
                update_progress()

        def _on_feedback_text(q_id, value):
            if value and value.strip():
                open_answers[q_id] = value.strip()
            else:
                open_answers.pop(q_id, None)

        def _on_demo_change(item_id, value):
            if value is not None:
                demo_answers[item_id] = value

        # ---- گویه‌های بسته ----
        for item in FEEDBACK_ITEMS:
            with ui.card().classes('w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-600 p-4'):
                ui.label(f"{item['id']}. {item['text']}").classes(
                    'text-base text-white w-full text-right leading-relaxed mb-3'
                )
                rb = ui.radio([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], value=None).props('inline').classes('w-full justify-center')
                rb.on_value_change(
                    lambda e, iid=item['id'], r=rb: _on_feedback_radio(iid, r.value)
                )

        # ---- سؤالات باز ----
        ui.separator().classes('my-4')
        ui.label('سؤالات باز').classes('text-xl font-bold text-cyan-400 w-full text-right')
        for q in FEEDBACK_OPEN_QUESTIONS:
            with ui.card().classes('w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-600 p-4 mt-2'):
                ui.label(q['text']).classes(
                    'text-base text-white w-full text-right leading-relaxed mb-3'
                )
                ta = ui.textarea(placeholder='پاسخ خود را اینجا بنویسید...').classes(
                    'w-full bg-slate-700 text-white text-base p-3 rounded'
                )
                ta.on_value_change(
                    lambda e, qid=q['id'], t=ta: _on_feedback_text(qid, t.value)
                )

        # ---- دموگرافیک تکمیلی ----
        ui.separator().classes('my-4')
        ui.label('اطلاعات تکمیلی').classes('text-xl font-bold text-cyan-400 w-full text-right')
        for item in FEEDBACK_DEMOGRAPHIC_ITEMS:
            with ui.card().classes('w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-600 p-4 mt-2'):
                ui.label(item['text']).classes(
                    'text-base text-white w-full text-right leading-relaxed mb-3'
                )
                rb = ui.radio(item['options'], value=None).props('inline').classes('w-full justify-center')
                rb.on_value_change(
                    lambda e, iid=item['id'], r=rb: _on_demo_change(iid, r.value)
                )

        async def submit_feedback():
            if len(close_answers) < len(FEEDBACK_ITEMS):
                ui.notify(
                    f'شما به {len(close_answers)} گویه از '
                    f'{len(FEEDBACK_ITEMS)} پاسخ داده‌اید.',
                    type='warning', position='top', timeout=4000,
                )
                return
            scores = compute_feedback_scores(close_answers)
            success = await run.io_bound(
                save_feedback_data,
                participant_id=participant_id,
                close_answers=close_answers,
                open_answers=open_answers,
                demographic_extra=demo_answers,
                scores=scores,
            )
            if not success:
                ui.notify('خطا در ذخیره‌ی داده.', type='negative', position='top', timeout=5000)
                return
            await run.io_bound(
                log_event_threadsafe,
                participant_id=participant_id,
                session_id=session_id,
                event_type='feedback_completed',
                scenario_id='feedback',
                metadata={'overall': scores['overall_score']},
            )
            ui.notify('✓ پاسخ‌های شما ثبت شد.', type='positive', position='top', timeout=3000)
            from web_app.navigation import next_after_feedback
            ui.navigate.to(next_after_feedback())

        ui.button('ثبت پاسخ‌ها و پایان', on_click=submit_feedback).classes(
            'w-full bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-500 text-white '
            'text-xl font-bold py-4 mt-4 rounded-lg'
        )

"""صفحه‌ی HEXACO-24"""
from nicegui import ui, app, run
from web_app.config import PAGE_CSS
from web_app.survey_helpers import render_likert_survey
from web_app.db_manager import save_hexaco_data, log_event_threadsafe

    HEXACO_ITEMS, LIKERT_LABELS, compute_factor_scores,
)
from web_app.components.audio_control import setup_page_audio


@ui.page('/hexaco')
def hexaco_page():
    participant_id = app.storage.user.get('participant_id')
    session_id = app.storage.user.get('session_id')
    if not participant_id or not session_id:
        ui.navigate.to('/')
        return

    setup_page_audio(None)

    ui.query('body').style(PAGE_CSS)

    with ui.column().classes('w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto p-8 gap-4'):
        with ui.row().classes('w-full justify-between items-center'):
            ui.label('HEXACO-24').classes('text-2xl font-bold text-cyan-400')
            ui.label(f'کد شما: {participant_id}').classes(
                'text-sm text-gray-400 font-mono bg-slate-800 px-3 py-1 rounded'
            )

        async def on_hexaco_submit(answers):
            scores = compute_factor_scores(answers)
            success = await run.io_bound(
                save_hexaco_data,
                participant_id=participant_id,
                answers=answers,
                scores=scores,
            )
            if not success:
                ui.notify(
                    'خطا در ذخیره‌ی داده. لطفاً دوباره تلاش کنید.',
                    type='negative', position='top', timeout=5000,
                )
                return
            await run.io_bound(
                log_event_threadsafe,
                participant_id=participant_id,
                session_id=session_id,
                event_type='hexaco_completed',
                scenario_id='hexaco',
                metadata={'scores': scores},
            )
            ui.notify(
                '✓ پاسخ‌های HEXACO ثبت شد.',
                type='positive', position='top', timeout=3000,
            )
            from web_app.navigation import next_after_hexaco
            ui.navigate.to(next_after_hexaco())

        render_likert_survey(
            items=HEXACO_ITEMS,
            labels=LIKERT_LABELS,
            on_submit=on_hexaco_submit,
            title='HEXACO-24',
            intro_text=(
                'لطفاً هر گزاره را با دقت بخوانید و مشخص کنید که '
                'چقدر با آن موافقید. هیچ پاسخ درست یا غلطی وجود '
                'ندارد؛ تنها نظر صادقانه شما مهم است.'
            ),
        )

// File: truthline_pyqt/web_app/pages/interlude.py

"""صفحه‌ی میان‌پرده — شامل epilogue"""
from nicegui import ui, app, run

from web_app.config import PAGE_CSS, get_interlude_next
from web_app.db_manager import (
    get_relationships_web,
    get_choice_memory,
    log_event_threadsafe,
)
from web_app.data.interludes import get_interlude
from web_app.data.epilogue import compute_epilogue
from web_app.components.dialogue_viewer import (
    render_dialogue_viewer,
)
from web_app.components.audio_control import setup_page_audio


@ui.page('/interlude/{day_key}')
async def interlude_page(day_key: str):
    participant_id = app.storage.user.get('participant_id')
    session_id = app.storage.user.get('session_id')
    if not participant_id or not session_id:
        ui.navigate.to('/')
        return

    setup_page_audio("interlude")

    ui.query('body').style(PAGE_CSS)

    # ---- بارگذاری روابط ----
    relationships = await run.io_bound(
        get_relationships_web, participant_id
    ) or {"li": 0, "rahimi": 0, "artemis": 0}

    # ---- محتوای میان‌پرده ----
    if day_key == "epilogue":
        choice_memory = await run.io_bound(
            get_choice_memory, participant_id
        ) or {}
        content = compute_epilogue(
            relationships, choice_memory
        )
    else:
        content = get_interlude(day_key, relationships)

    if not content:
        next_url = get_interlude_next(day_key)
        ui.navigate.to('/' + next_url)
        return

    # ---- ثبت رویداد ----
    await run.io_bound(
        log_event_threadsafe,
        participant_id=participant_id,
        session_id=session_id,
        event_type='interlude_started',
        scenario_id=f'interlude_{day_key}',
        metadata={'relationships': relationships},
    )

    # ---- HUD ----
    from web_app.components.hud import render_hud

    stage_key_map = {
        "day2": "interlude2",
        "day3": "interlude3",
        "day4": "interlude4",
        "epilogue": "epilogue",
    }
    await render_hud(
        stage_key=stage_key_map.get(day_key, ""),
        sub_progress=0.0,
    )

    container = ui.column().classes(
        'w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto p-8 gap-4'
    )

    async def go_to_next():
        from web_app.navigation import next_after_interlude
        ui.navigate.to(next_after_interlude(day_key))

    with container:
        await render_dialogue_viewer(
            dialogues=content.get("dialogues", []),
            on_complete=go_to_next,
            image_path=content.get("image"),
            title=content.get("title", ""),
            subtitle=content.get("subtitle", ""),
            body_text=content.get("body_text", ""),
        )

# صفحه
# ============================================================
@ui.page('/intro')
async def intro_page():
    participant_id = app.storage.user.get('participant_id')
    session_id = app.storage.user.get('session_id')

    if not participant_id or not session_id:
        ui.navigate.to('/')
        return

    # ✅ موسیقی مقدمه (station_calm)
    setup_page_audio("intro")

    ui.query('body').style(PAGE_CSS)

    # ---- state ----
    state = {"idx": 0, "advancing": False}

    container = ui.column().classes(
        'w-full max-w-3xl mx-auto p-6 gap-4'
    )

    # ---- توابع ----
    async def _advance():
        if state["advancing"]:
            return
        state["advancing"] = True
        try:
            state["idx"] += 1
            if state["idx"] >= len(INTRO_DIALOGUES):
                await _go_to_phase1()
                return
            await _render()
        finally:
            state["advancing"] = False

    async def _go_to_phase1():
        from web_app.audio import play_transition_sfx
        play_transition_sfx()

        # ثبت لاگ
        try:
            from web_app.db_manager import log_event_threadsafe
            from nicegui import run
            await run.io_bound(
                log_event_threadsafe,
                participant_id=participant_id,
                session_id=session_id,
                event_type='intro_completed',
                scenario_id='intro',
                metadata={
                    "total_dialogues": len(INTRO_DIALOGUES),
                },
            )
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ intro log: {e}")

        ui.notify(
            '✓ مقدمه تکمیل شد. انتقال به روز اول...',
            type='positive', position='top', timeout=2500,
        )
        ui.navigate.to('/phase1')

    async def _render():
        container.clear()
        idx = state["idx"]

        with container:
            # ---- پس‌زمینه‌ی ایستگاه ----
            with ui.card().classes(
                'w-full bg-slate-900 border-2 border-cyan-400 '
                'p-2 overflow-hidden'
            ):
                ui.image(
                    '/assets/backgrounds/menu_hero_v01.png'
                ).classes(
                    'w-full rounded object-cover'
                ).style('max-height: 260px;')

            # ---- عنوان ----
            ui.label("ایستگاه پژوهشی مداری کاسپین").classes(
                'text-2xl font-bold text-cyan-400 '
                'text-center w-full'
            )
            ui.label("سال ۲۱۴۸").classes(
                'text-sm text-gray-400 text-center w-full mb-2'
            )

            # ---- نوار پیشرفت ----
            if idx < len(INTRO_DIALOGUES):
                with ui.row().classes(
                    'items-center gap-2 w-full justify-between'
                ):
                    ui.label("مقدمه").classes(
                        'text-xs text-cyan-400 font-bold'
                    )
                    ui.label(
                        f"{idx + 1} از {len(INTRO_DIALOGUES)}"
                    ).classes(
                        'text-xs text-gray-400 font-mono'
                    )
                ui.linear_progress(
                    value=(idx + 1) / len(INTRO_DIALOGUES),
                    show_value=False,
                ).classes('w-full mb-2')

            # ---- دیالوگ فعلی ----
            if idx < len(INTRO_DIALOGUES):
                d = INTRO_DIALOGUES[idx]
                speaker = str(d.get("speaker", "") or "")
                text = str(d.get("text", "") or "")

                # ✅ پرتره
                portrait_url = resolve_portrait_url(
                    speaker, text
                )

                with ui.card().classes(
                    'w-full bg-slate-800 border-2 border-cyan-400 '
                    'p-4'
                ):
                    with ui.row().classes(
                        'items-start gap-4 w-full no-wrap'
                    ):
                        # پرتره (راست در RTL)
                        if portrait_url:
                            with ui.element('div').classes(
                                'flex-shrink-0'
                            ):
                                ui.image(portrait_url).style(
                                    'width: 100px; height: 130px; '
                                    'border-radius: 10px; '
                                    'border: 2px solid #4FC3F7; '
                                    'object-fit: cover; '
                                    'background: #0B1D3A;'
                                )
                        # محتوا
                        with ui.column().classes(
                            'flex-1 gap-2'
                        ):
                            ui.label(
                                f"[{speaker}]"
                            ).classes(
                                'text-sm text-cyan-400 '
                                'font-bold w-full text-right'
                            )
                            ui.label(text).classes(
                                'text-base text-white '
                                'leading-relaxed w-full '
                                'text-right '
                                'whitespace-pre-line'
                            )

                # ---- دکمه‌ی ادامه ----
                is_last = (idx + 1 >= len(INTRO_DIALOGUES))
                btn_text = (
                    'ورود به روز اول' if is_last else 'ادامه'
                )
                ui.button(
                    btn_text, on_click=_advance,
                ).classes(
                    'w-full py-3 text-lg font-bold '
                    'bg-cyan-600 hover:bg-cyan-500 mt-2'
                )
                ui.label(
                    "می‌توانید کلید Space یا Enter را هم بزنید"
                ).classes(
                    'text-xs text-gray-500 text-center '
                    'w-full italic'
                )

    # ---- پشتیبانی کیبورد (Space/Enter) ----
    try:
        def _kb_handler(e):
            try:
                if (
                    e.action.keydown
                    and e.key.name in (" ", "Space", "Enter")
                ):
                    asyncio.create_task(_advance())
            except Exception:
                pass

        ui.keyboard(on_key=_kb_handler)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ keyboard disabled: {e}")

    # ---- رندر اولیه ----
    await _render()

// File: truthline_pyqt/web_app/pages/letter_to_self.py

"""
صفحه‌ی نامه به خود
====================
- یک متن آزاد پیش از پایان مأموریت
- ذخیره در جدول web_self_letters
- در حالت TEST_MODE قابل پرش است

نسخه: 1.0.0
"""
from nicegui import ui, app, run

from web_app.config import PAGE_CSS, TEST_MODE
from web_app.db_manager import (
    save_self_letter, log_event_threadsafe,
)
from web_app.components.audio_control import setup_page_audio


@ui.page('/letter-to-self')
def letter_to_self_page():
    participant_id = app.storage.user.get('participant_id')
    session_id = app.storage.user.get('session_id')

    if not participant_id or not session_id:
        ui.navigate.to('/')
        return

    setup_page_audio(None)

    ui.query('body').style(PAGE_CSS)

    # ---- HUD ----
    from web_app.components.hud import render_hud
    # letter_to_self جزو GAME_STAGES نیست، پس HUD نمی‌گذاریم
    # یا می‌توانیم از مرحله‌ی قبلی استفاده کنیم
    # await render_hud(stage_key="phase4", sub_progress=1.0)

    # ---- container ----
    with ui.column().classes(
        'w-full max-w-3xl mx-auto p-8 gap-4'
    ):
        # سرصفحه
        with ui.row().classes(
            'w-full justify-between items-center'
        ):
            ui.label('نامه به خود').classes(
                'text-3xl font-bold text-cyan-400'
            )
            ui.label(
                f'کد شما: {participant_id}'
            ).classes(
                'text-sm text-gray-400 font-mono '
                'bg-slate-800 px-3 py-1 rounded'
            )

        # مقدمه
        ui.label(
            'پیش از دیدن نتایج نهایی، این لحظه فقط مال '
            'خودت است. اگر بخواهی به خودت، به آن کسی '
            'که در این چهار روز تصمیم گرفت، یک جمله '
            'بگویی، آن جمله چیست؟'
        ).classes(
            'text-base text-gray-300 text-center '
            'leading-relaxed p-4 bg-slate-800 rounded '
            'w-full mt-2 mb-4'
        )

        # textarea
        letter_input = ui.textarea(
            placeholder=(
                'اینجا بنویس... (اگر نمی‌خواهی، '
                'می‌توانی خالی بگذاری)'
            )
        ).classes('w-full text-base p-3 rounded').style(
            'min-height: 220px; font-family: Vazirmatn;'
        )

        # شمارنده
        counter_label = ui.label('۰ کلمه').classes(
            'text-xs text-gray-400 w-full text-right'
        )

        def _update_counter():
            text = letter_input.value or ''
            words = len(text.split()) if text.strip() else 0
            counter_label.set_text(f'{words} کلمه')

        letter_input.on_value_change(
            lambda e: _update_counter()
        )

        # ---- دکمه‌ها ----
        async def _save_and_continue():
            text = (letter_input.value or '').strip()
            try:
                await run.io_bound(
                    save_self_letter,
                    participant_id=participant_id,
                    content=text,
                )
            except Exception as e:
                print(f'⚠️ خطا در ذخیره‌ی نامه: {e}')

            try:
                await run.io_bound(
                    log_event_threadsafe,
                    participant_id=participant_id,
                    session_id=session_id,
                    event_type='letter_submitted',
                    scenario_id='letter_to_self',
                    metadata={
                        'word_count': (
                            len(text.split()) if text else 0
                        ),
                        'char_count': len(text),
                    },
                )
            except Exception as e:
                print(f'⚠️ خطا در لاگ: {e}')

            ui.notify(
                '✓ نامه ذخیره شد. انتقال به پرسشنامه‌ها...',
                type='positive', position='top', timeout=2500,
            )
            ui.navigate.to('/hexaco')

        async def _skip():
            try:
                await run.io_bound(
                    save_self_letter,
                    participant_id=participant_id,
                    content='',
                )
            except Exception as e:
                print(f'⚠️ خطا در ذخیره‌ی رد کردن: {e}')

            try:
                await run.io_bound(
                    log_event_threadsafe,
                    participant_id=participant_id,
                    session_id=session_id,
                    event_type='letter_skipped',
                    scenario_id='letter_to_self',
                    metadata={},
                )
            except Exception as e:
                print(f'⚠️ خطا در لاگ: {e}')

            ui.notify(
                'رد شد — ادامه به پرسشنامه‌ها',
                type='info', position='top', timeout=2000,
            )
            ui.navigate.to('/hexaco')

        with ui.row().classes('w-full gap-3 mt-2'):
            ui.button(
                'رد کردن', on_click=_skip,
            ).classes(
                'flex-1 bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-600 '
                'text-white text-base font-bold py-3 '
                'rounded-lg'
            )
            ui.button(
                'ذخیره و ادامه', on_click=_save_and_continue,
            ).classes(
                'flex-[2] bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-500 '
                'text-white text-base font-bold py-3 '
                'rounded-lg'
            )

// File: truthline_pyqt/web_app/pages/night.py

"""صفحه‌ی شب ایستگاه"""
from nicegui import ui, app, run

from web_app.config import (
    PAGE_CSS, NIGHT_NEXT, load_night_data,
)
from web_app.db_manager import (
    update_relationship_web, log_event_threadsafe,
    get_relationships_web,
)
from web_app.components.dialogue_viewer import (
    render_dialogue_viewer,
)
from web_app.components.audio_control import setup_page_audio


@ui.page('/night/{night_num}')
async def night_page(night_num: str):
    participant_id = app.storage.user.get('participant_id')
    session_id = app.storage.user.get('session_id')
    if not participant_id or not session_id:
        ui.navigate.to('/')
        return

    setup_page_audio("night")

    ui.query('body').style(PAGE_CSS)

    # ---- HUD ----
    from web_app.components.hud import render_hud
    await render_hud(
        stage_key=f"night{night_num}",
        sub_progress=0.0,
    )

    night_data = load_night_data(night_num)
    if not night_data:
        # داده‌ی این شب نبود — مستقیم برو به بعدی
        from web_app.navigation import next_after_night
        ui.navigate.to(next_after_night(int(night_num)))
        return

    container = ui.column().classes(
        'w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto p-8 gap-4'
    )

    async def go_to_next():
        from web_app.navigation import next_after_night
        ui.navigate.to(next_after_night(int(night_num)))

    async def render_choices():
        container.clear()
        with container:
            # ---- هدر ----
            ui.label(night_data.get("title", "")).classes(
                'text-3xl font-bold text-cyan-400 '
                'text-center w-full'
            )
            ui.label(night_data.get("subtitle", "")).classes(
                'text-xl text-orange-400 text-center w-full'
            )

            # ---- مقدمه ----
            if night_data.get("intro"):
                with ui.card().classes(
                    'w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-600 '
                    'p-4 mt-2'
                ):
                    ui.label(
                        night_data["intro"]
                    ).classes(
                        'text-base text-gray-300 leading-relaxed '
                        'w-full text-right whitespace-pre-line'
                    )

            # ---- دستور ----
            ui.label(
                "این شب را چطور می‌گذرانی؟"
            ).classes(
                'text-lg font-bold text-white w-full text-right mt-4'
            )

            # ---- فعالیت‌ها ----
            activities = night_data.get("activities", {})
            order = ["li", "artemis", "stars"]

            for key in order:
                activity = activities.get(key)
                if not activity:
                    continue

                async def _pick(k=key):
                    await on_activity_chosen(k)

                with ui.card().classes(
                    'w-full bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-600 '
                    'border-2 border-slate-500 cursor-pointer p-4 mt-2'
                ).on('click', _pick):
                    with ui.column().classes('gap-1 w-full'):
                        ui.label(
                            activity.get("label", key)
                        ).classes(
                            'text-base text-white font-bold '
                            'w-full text-right'
                        )
                        if activity.get("hint"):
                            ui.label(
                                activity["hint"]
                            ).classes(
                                'text-sm text-gray-400 italic '
                                'w-full text-right'
                            )

    async def on_activity_chosen(activity_key: str):
        activity = night_data.get("activities", {}).get(
            activity_key
        )
        if not activity:
            return

        # ✅ صدای انتخاب
        from web_app.audio import play_choice_sfx
        play_choice_sfx()

        # ---- اعمال اثر بر روابط ----
        effect = activity.get("effect", {}) or {}
        for char, delta in effect.items():
            await run.io_bound(
                update_relationship_web,
                participant_id=participant_id,
                character_key=char,
                delta=int(delta),
            )

        # ---- ثبت رویداد ----
        await run.io_bound(
            log_event_threadsafe,
            participant_id=participant_id,
            session_id=session_id,
            event_type='night_activity_chosen',
            scenario_id=f'night_{night_num}',
            metadata={
                'activity': activity_key,
                'effect': effect,
            },
        )

        # ---- نمایش دیالوگ‌های فعالیت ----
        container.clear()
        with container:
            await render_dialogue_viewer(
                dialogues=activity.get("dialogues", []),
                on_complete=go_to_next,
                title=night_data.get("title", ""),
                subtitle=night_data.get("subtitle", ""),
            )

    await render_choices()

"""صفحه‌ی فاز ۲ (روز دوم)"""
from nicegui import ui, app
from web_app.config import PAGE_CSS, PHASE_SCENARIOS, PHASE_TITLES
from web_app.engine.scenario_runner import render_phase
from web_app.components.audio_control import setup_page_audio


@ui.page('/phase2')
async def phase2_page():
    participant_id = app.storage.user.get('participant_id')
    session_id = app.storage.user.get('session_id')
    if not participant_id or not session_id:
        ui.navigate.to('/')
        return

    setup_page_audio("phase2")

    ui.query('body').style(PAGE_CSS)

    with ui.column().classes('w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto p-8 gap-4'):
        async def on_phase2_complete():
            ui.notify(
                '✓ پایان فاز ۲. انتقال به شب دوم...',
                type='positive', position='top', timeout=3000,
            )

def _level(score: float) -> str:
    if score >= 70:
        return "high"
    if score >= 40:
        return "mid"
    return "low"

# ============================================================
# محاسبه‌ی Consistency (CO-01، CO-02، CO-03)
# ============================================================
def _compute_pair_score(v1: float, v2: float) -> float:
    """فرمول ترکیبی ثبات + کیفیت اخلاقی."""
    similarity = 1.0 - abs(v1 - v2)
    quality = (v1 + v2) / 2.0
    return round(0.4 * similarity + 0.6 * quality, 3)


def _compute_and_save_consistency(participant_id: str):
    """
    محاسبه‌ی سه شاخص ثبات بین جفت‌سناریوها و ذخیره در web_evidence.
    (همان منطق دسکتاپ — CO-01، CO-02، CO-03)
    """
    from web_app.db_manager import get_connection

    try:
        conn = get_connection()
        c = conn.cursor()

        # اگر قبلاً محاسبه شده → پرش
        c.execute("""
            SELECT 1 FROM web_evidence
            WHERE participant_id = ? AND scenario_id = 'CO-computed'
              AND evidence_key = 'E_CO1_moral_consistency'
            LIMIT 1
        """, (participant_id,))
        if c.fetchone():
            print("   [CO] قبلاً محاسبه شده — پرش")
            conn.close()
            return

        def _read(sid: str, ev_key: str) -> float | None:
            c.execute("""
                SELECT evidence_value FROM web_evidence
                WHERE participant_id = ? AND scenario_id = ?
                  AND evidence_key = ?
                LIMIT 1
            """, (participant_id, sid, ev_key))
            row = c.fetchone()
            return float(row[0]) if row else None

        import time as _t
        now = _t.time()
        inserted = []

        # ---- CO-01: MC-01 vs MC-02 ----
        mc1 = _read("MC-01", "E_MC1_action_type")
        mc2 = _read("MC-02", "E_MC2_integrity")
        if mc1 is not None and mc2 is not None:
            co1 = _compute_pair_score(mc1, mc2)
            c.execute("""
                INSERT INTO web_evidence
                (participant_id, scenario_id, competency,
                 evidence_key, evidence_value, weight, timestamp)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """, (
                participant_id, "CO-computed", "honesty",
                "E_CO1_moral_consistency", co1, 0.8, now,
            ))
            inserted.append(f"CO-01={co1:.3f}")

        # ---- CO-02: PI-01 vs RG-01 ----
        pi1 = _read("PI-01", "E_PI2_report_completeness")
        rg1 = _read("RG-01", "E_RG1_initial_tone")
        if pi1 is not None and rg1 is not None:
            co2 = _compute_pair_score(pi1, rg1)
            c.execute("""
                INSERT INTO web_evidence
                (participant_id, scenario_id, competency,
                 evidence_key, evidence_value, weight, timestamp)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """, (
                participant_id, "CO-computed", "accountability",
                "E_CO2_accountability_consistency",
                co2, 0.8, now,
            ))
            inserted.append(f"CO-02={co2:.3f}")

        # ---- CO-03: CF-01 vs CF-02 ----
        cf1 = _read("CF-01", "E_CF1_delivery_success")
        cf2 = _read("CF-02", "E_CF2_quality")
        if cf1 is not None and cf2 is not None:
            co3 = _compute_pair_score(cf1, cf2)
            c.execute("""
                INSERT INTO web_evidence
                (participant_id, scenario_id, competency,
                 evidence_key, evidence_value, weight, timestamp)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """, (
                participant_id, "CO-computed", "trustworthiness",
                "E_CO3_behavioral_consistency", co3, 0.8, now,
            ))
            inserted.append(f"CO-03={co3:.3f}")

        conn.commit()
        conn.close()

        if inserted:
            print(f"   [CO] ثبت شد: {', '.join(inserted)}")
        else:
            print("   [CO] داده‌ی کافی نبود — پرش")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"   [CO] خطا: {e}")

def _compute_sub_competencies(participant_id: str):
    """
    محاسبه‌ی نمره‌ی هر زیرمؤلفه از شواهد و ذخیره در دیتابیس.
    """
    from collections import defaultdict
    from web_app.db_manager import (
        get_connection, save_sub_competency_scores,
    )

    try:
        conn = get_connection()
        c = conn.cursor()
        c.execute("""
            SELECT competency, evidence_key,
                   evidence_value, weight
            FROM web_evidence
            WHERE participant_id = ?
        """, (participant_id,))
        rows = c.fetchall()
        conn.close()

        sums = defaultdict(
            lambda: defaultdict(
                lambda: {"sum": 0.0, "weight": 0.0, "count": 0}
            )
        )

        for comp, ev_key, value, weight in rows:
            comp_str = str(comp or "")
            key_str = str(ev_key or "")
            v = float(value or 0.0)
            w = float(weight or 0.0)

            sub = SUB_COMP_MAP.get(key_str)
            if not sub:
                sub = DEFAULT_SUB.get(comp_str)
            if not sub:
                continue

            d = sums[comp_str][sub]
            d["sum"] += v * w
            d["weight"] += w
            d["count"] += 1

        final: dict = {}
        for comp, subs in sums.items():
            final[comp] = {}
            for sub, d in subs.items():
                if d["weight"] > 0:
                    score = (d["sum"] / d["weight"]) * 100
                else:
                    score = 0.0
                final[comp][sub] = {
                    "score": round(score, 2),
                    "count": int(d["count"]),
                }

        if final:
            save_sub_competency_scores(participant_id, final)
            print(
                f"   [SUB] ذخیره شد: "
                f"{sum(len(v) for v in final.values())} زیرمؤلفه"
            )
        return final
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"   [SUB] خطا: {e}")
        return {}

# ============================================================
# MRL (Moral Reasoning Level)
# ============================================================
def _compute_mrl(participant_id: str) -> dict:
    """
    محاسبه‌ی سطح استدلال اخلاقی از توزیع طرح‌واره‌ها.
    """
    from web_app.db_manager import get_schema_distribution

    dist = get_schema_distribution(participant_id)
    pi = dist.get("personal_interest", 0)
    mn = dist.get("maintaining_norms", 0)
    pc = dist.get("postconventional", 0)
    total = pi + mn + pc

    if total == 0:
        return {
            "level": "unknown",
            "score": 0.0,
            "pi": 0, "mn": 0, "pc": 0, "total": 0,
        }

    raw = (pc * 2) - (pi * 1) + (mn * 0.5)
    normalized = raw / (total * 2)

    if normalized > 0.25:
        level = "postconventional"
    elif normalized > -0.25:
        level = "maintaining_norms"
    else:
        level = "personal_interest"

    return {
        "level": level,
        "score": round(normalized, 3),
        "pi": pi, "mn": mn, "pc": pc, "total": total,
    }

def compute_scores(participant_id: str) -> dict:
    """
    محاسبه‌ی نمره‌ی هر شایستگی از شواهد ثبت‌شده.

    Returns:
        {competency: {"score": float, "count": int}}
    """
    conn = get_connection()
    c = conn.cursor()
    c.execute("""
        SELECT competency,
               SUM(evidence_value * weight) /
                   NULLIF(SUM(weight), 0) * 100 as score,
               COUNT(*) as cnt
        FROM web_evidence
        WHERE participant_id = ?
        GROUP BY competency
    """, (participant_id,))
    result = {}
    for comp, score, cnt in c.fetchall():
        result[comp] = {
            "score": round(score or 0.0, 1),
            "count": cnt,
        }
    conn.close()
    return result


# ✅ TypeVar + cast برای رفع خطای Pylance
_T = TypeVar("_T")


async def _io(func: Callable[..., _T], **kwargs: Any) -> _T:
    """
    نسخه‌ی type-safe از run.io_bound.
    Pylance را قانع می‌کند که نتیجه هم‌نوع با تابع ورودی است.
    """
    result = await run.io_bound(func, **kwargs)
    return cast(_T, result)


@ui.page('/results')
async def results_page():
    participant_id = app.storage.user.get('participant_id')
    if not participant_id:
        ui.navigate.to('/')
        return

    setup_page_audio("results")

    ui.query('body').style(PAGE_CSS)

    # ✅ ۱. محاسبه‌ی consistency (CO-01/02/03)
    await _io(
        _compute_and_save_consistency,
        participant_id=participant_id,
    )

    # ✅ ۲. محاسبه‌ی زیرمؤلفه‌ها
    sub_scores: dict = (
        await _io(
            _compute_sub_competencies,
            participant_id=participant_id,
        )
    ) or {}

    # ✅ محاسبه‌ی MRL
    mrl: dict = (
        await _io(_compute_mrl, participant_id=participant_id)
    ) or {"level": "unknown"}

    # ✅ ۳. محاسبه‌ی نمرات اصلی
    scores: dict = (
        await _io(compute_scores, participant_id=participant_id)
    ) or {}
    relationships: dict = (
        await _io(
            get_relationships_web, participant_id=participant_id
        )
    ) or {}

    values = [
        scores.get(c, {}).get("score", 0.0)
        for c in COMPETENCY_ORDER
    ]
    labels = [COMPETENCY_FA[c] for c in COMPETENCY_ORDER]

    avg = sum(values) / len(values) if values else 0.0

    # ---- تعیین برچسب کلی ----
    if avg >= 80:
        badge_text = "الگوی متعالی"
        badge_color = "#4CAF50"
    elif avg >= 65:
        badge_text = "الگوی متعادل"
        badge_color = "#4FC3F7"
    elif avg >= 45:
        badge_text = "در حال توسعه"
        badge_color = "#FF8F00"
    else:
        badge_text = "نیازمند بازنگری"
        badge_color = "#D32F2F"

    with ui.column().classes(
        'w-full max-w-3xl mx-auto p-8 gap-4'
    ):
        # ---- عنوان ----
        ui.label("نیمرخ شایستگی عملیاتی").classes(
            'text-3xl font-bold text-cyan-400 text-center'
        )
        ui.label(
            "بر اساس شواهد رفتاری ثبت‌شده در طول مأموریت"
        ).classes(
            'text-base text-gray-400 text-center mb-2'
        )

        # ---- بج کلی ----
        with ui.row().classes('w-full justify-center mb-2'):
            ui.label(badge_text).classes(
                'text-base font-bold px-4 py-2 rounded-full'
            ).style(
                f"color: #0B1D3A; background-color: {badge_color};"
            )
        ui.label(
            f"میانگین کل: {avg:.1f} از ۱۰۰"
        ).classes(
            'text-sm text-gray-300 text-center mb-4'
        )

        # ✅ بج MRL
        level_map = {
            "postconventional": (

// File: truthline_pyqt/web_app/pages/sd.py

"""صفحه‌ی مطلوبیت اجتماعی"""
from nicegui import ui, app, run
from web_app.config import PAGE_CSS
from web_app.db_manager import save_social_desirability_data, log_event_threadsafe
from web_app.data.items.social_desirability_items import SD_ITEMS, compute_sd_score
from web_app.components.audio_control import setup_page_audio


@ui.page('/sd')
def sd_page():
    participant_id = app.storage.user.get('participant_id')
    session_id = app.storage.user.get('session_id')
    if not participant_id or not session_id:
        ui.navigate.to('/')
        return

    setup_page_audio(None)

    ui.query('body').style(PAGE_CSS)
    answers = {}

    with ui.column().classes('w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto p-8 gap-4'):
        with ui.row().classes('w-full justify-between items-center'):
            ui.label('مطلوبیت اجتماعی').classes('text-2xl font-bold text-cyan-400')
            ui.label(f'کد شما: {participant_id}').classes(
                'text-sm text-gray-400 font-mono bg-slate-800 px-3 py-1 rounded'
            )

        ui.label(
            'با پاسخ گفتن به هر یک از ماده‌های زیر، درباره‌ی شخصیتتان '
            'پی ببرید. هر جمله را بخوانید و تعیین کنید که آیا در مورد '
            'شما درست است یا غلط.'
        ).classes(
            'text-base text-gray-300 text-center leading-relaxed '
            'p-4 bg-slate-800 rounded w-full mt-2 mb-4'
        )

        progress_label = ui.label(f'0 از {len(SD_ITEMS)}').classes(
            'text-center text-orange-400 font-bold w-full mb-4'
        )

        def update_progress():
            progress_label.set_text(f'{len(answers)} از {len(SD_ITEMS)}')

        def _on_sd_change(item_id, value):
            if value is not None:
                answers[item_id] = (value == 'درست')
                update_progress()

        for item in SD_ITEMS:
            with ui.card().classes('w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-600 p-4'):
                ui.label(f"{item['id']}. {item['text']}").classes(
                    'text-base text-white w-full text-right leading-relaxed mb-3'
                )
                rb = ui.radio(['درست', 'غلط'], value=None).props('inline').classes('w-full justify-center')
                rb.on_value_change(
                    lambda e, iid=item['id'], r=rb: _on_sd_change(iid, r.value)
                )

        async def submit_sd():
            if len(answers) < len(SD_ITEMS):
                ui.notify(
                    f'شما به {len(answers)} گویه از {len(SD_ITEMS)} '
                    f'پاسخ داده‌اید.',
                    type='warning', position='top', timeout=4000,
                )
                return
            result = compute_sd_score(answers)
            success = await run.io_bound(
                save_social_desirability_data,
                participant_id=participant_id,
                answers=answers,
                result=result,
            )
            if not success:
                ui.notify('خطا در ذخیره‌ی داده.', type='negative', position='top', timeout=5000)
                return
            await run.io_bound(
                log_event_threadsafe,
                participant_id=participant_id,
                session_id=session_id,
                event_type='sd_completed',
                scenario_id='sd',
                metadata={'score': result['score']},
            )
            ui.notify('✓ پاسخ‌ها ثبت شد.', type='positive', position='top', timeout=3000)
            from web_app.navigation import next_after_sd
            ui.navigate.to(next_after_sd())

        ui.button('ثبت پاسخ‌ها و ادامه', on_click=submit_sd).classes(
            'w-full bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-500 text-white '
            'text-xl font-bold py-4 mt-4 rounded-lg'
        )

from nicegui import ui, app, run

)

@ui.page('/sd3')
def sd3_page():
    participant_id = app.storage.user.get('participant_id')
    session_id = app.storage.user.get('session_id')
    if not participant_id or not session_id:
        ui.navigate.to('/')
        return

    setup_page_audio(None)

    ui.query('body').style(PAGE_CSS)

    with ui.column().classes('w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto p-8 gap-4'):

            ui.label('SD3 — مثلث تاریک').classes('text-2xl font-bold text-cyan-400')
            ui.label(f'کد شما: {participant_id}').classes(
                'text-sm text-gray-400 font-mono bg-slate-800 px-3 py-1 rounded'
            )

        async def on_sd3_submit(answers):
            scores = compute_sd3_scores(answers)
            success = await run.io_bound(
                save_sd3_data,
                participant_id=participant_id,
                answers=answers,
                scores=scores,
            )
            if not success:
                ui.notify('خطا در ذخیره‌ی داده.', type='negative', position='top', timeout=5000)
                return
            await run.io_bound(
                log_event_threadsafe,
                participant_id=participant_id,
                session_id=session_id,
                event_type='sd3_completed',
                scenario_id='sd3',
                metadata={'scores': scores},
            )
            ui.notify('✓ پاسخ‌های SD3 ثبت شد.', type='positive', position='top', timeout=3000)
            from web_app.navigation import next_after_sd3
            ui.navigate.to(next_after_sd3())

        render_likert_survey(
            items=SD3_ITEMS,
            labels=SD3_LIKERT_LABELS,
            on_submit=on_sd3_submit,
            title='SD3 — مثلث تاریک',
            intro_text=(
                'لطفاً مشخص کنید چقدر با هر یک از جملات زیر موافقید. '
                'پاسخ صادقانه شما بسیار مهم است.'
            ),
        )
