        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QFrame#traySlot {
                background-color: rgba(26, 42, 74, 0.6);
                border: 1px dashed #4FC3F7;
                border-radius: 8px;
            }
        """)

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(10, 8, 10, 8)
        layout.setSpacing(8)

        self.icon_lbl = QLabel("—")
        self.icon_lbl.setFont(QFont("Arial", 22))
        self.icon_lbl.setStyleSheet("border: none;")
        self.icon_lbl.setFixedWidth(32)
        layout.addWidget(self.icon_lbl)

        self.name_lbl = QLabel(placeholder)
        self.name_lbl.setFont(QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 11))
        self.name_lbl.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #666666; border: none; "
            "font-style: italic;"
        )
        layout.addWidget(self.name_lbl, 1)

        self.clear_btn = QPushButton("✕")
        self.clear_btn.setFont(QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 12))
        self.clear_btn.setFixedSize(26, 26)
        self.clear_btn.setCursor(
            Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor
        )
        self.clear_btn.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.NoFocus)
        self.clear_btn.setVisible(False)
        self.clear_btn.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton {
                background-color: transparent;
                color: #D32F2F;
                border: 1px solid #D32F2F;
                border-radius: 13px;
                padding: 0;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                background-color: #D32F2F;
                color: #FFFFFF;
            }
        """)
        self.clear_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_clear)
        layout.addWidget(self.clear_btn)

    def set_item(self, item_id: str, name: str, icon: str):
        self.item_id = item_id
        self.icon_lbl.setText(icon)
        self.name_lbl.setText(name)
        self.name_lbl.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #FFFFFF; border: none;"
        )
        self.clear_btn.setVisible(True)

    def clear_item(self):
        self.item_id = None
        self.icon_lbl.setText("—")
        self.name_lbl.setText(self._placeholder)
        self.name_lbl.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #666666; border: none; "
            "font-style: italic;"
        )
        self.clear_btn.setVisible(False)

    def _on_clear(self):
        if self.item_id is not None:
            old = self.item_id
            self.clear_item()
            self.removed.emit(old)


# ====================================================================
# ویجت اصلی پازل
# ====================================================================
class PuzzleWidget(QWidget):
    """پازل ترکیب — با Drag&Drop"""

    puzzle_done = pyqtSignal(dict)

    def __init__(self, items: list, valid_combinations: list,
                 solution_hint: str = "", parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.items = items
        self.valid_combinations = [
            set(c) for c in valid_combinations
        ]
        self.solution_hint = solution_hint

        self.start_time = int(time.time() * 1000)
        self.attempted_combinations: list = []
        self.solved = False
        self.solution_time_ms = 0

        self.item_map = {i["id"]: i for i in items}
        self.item_cards: dict = {}
        self._sparkles: list = []

        # انیمیشن sparkle
        self._sparkle_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._sparkle_timer.timeout.connect(self._tick_sparkles)

        self._setup_ui()
        self.setLayoutDirection(Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft)

    # ================================================================
    def _setup_ui(self):
        main_layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        main_layout.setContentsMargins(30, 12, 30, 12)
        main_layout.setSpacing(10)

        title = QLabel("در قفل‌شده")
        tf = QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 18)
        tf.setBold(True)
        title.setFont(tf)
        title.setStyleSheet("color: #4FC3F7;")
        title.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        main_layout.addWidget(title)

        desc = QLabel(
            "دو آیتم را بکشید و در سینی ترکیب رها کنید. "
            "سپس دکمه‌ی «ترکیب» را بزنید."
        )
        desc.setFont(QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 11))
        desc.setStyleSheet("color: #CCCCCC;")
        desc.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        desc.setWordWrap(True)
        main_layout.addWidget(desc)

        # سینی ترکیب
        self.tray = _CombineTray()
        self.tray.item_dropped.connect(self._on_item_dropped)
        self.tray.item_removed.connect(self._on_item_removed)
        self.tray.combine_requested.connect(self._on_combine)
        main_layout.addWidget(self.tray)

        # آیتم‌ها
        items_label = QLabel("آیتم‌های موجود:")
        items_label.setFont(
            QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 12, QFont.Weight.Bold)
        )
        items_label.setStyleSheet("color: #FFFFFF;")
        main_layout.addWidget(items_label)

        # ✅ چیدمان دوستونی
        items_grid = QGridLayout()
        items_grid.setHorizontalSpacing(8)
        items_grid.setVerticalSpacing(6)

        for i, item in enumerate(self.items):
            row = i // 2
            col = i % 2
            card = _DraggableItem(item)
            items_grid.addWidget(card, row, col)
            self.item_cards[item["id"]] = card

        main_layout.addLayout(items_grid)
        main_layout.addStretch()

    # ================================================================
    def _on_item_dropped(self, item_id: str):
        if self.solved:
            return
        item = self.item_map.get(item_id)
        if item is None:
            return

        # اگر قبلاً در سینی است، نادیده بگیر
        current = self.tray.get_items()
        if item_id in current:
            return

        self.tray.add_item(
            item_id, item["name"], item.get("icon", "●")
        )
        # به‌روزرسانی کارت
        card = self.item_cards.get(item_id)
        if card is not None:
            card.set_used(True)

        # صدای drop
        try:
            from core.audio_manager import get_audio_manager
            get_audio_manager().play_sfx("click")
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _on_item_removed(self, item_id: str):
        card = self.item_cards.get(item_id)
        if card is not None:
            card.set_used(False)

    # ================================================================
    def _on_combine(self):
        if self.solved:
            return

        items = self.tray.get_items()
        if None in items or len(items) != 2:
            return

        # ✅ پخش صدای دکمه‌ی ترکیب
        try:
            from core.audio_manager import get_audio_manager
            get_audio_manager().play_sfx("scan")
        except Exception:
            pass

        combo = set(items)
        self.attempted_combinations.append(
            tuple(sorted(items))
        )
        print(f"   [CFI-01] تلاش: {items}")

        if any(combo == vc for vc in self.valid_combinations):
            # موفق
            self.solved = True
            self.solution_time_ms = (
                int(time.time() * 1000) - self.start_time
            )
            print(
                f"   [CFI-01] حل شد در "
                f"{self.solution_time_ms}ms"
            )

            # افکت sparkle سبز
            self.tray.flash("#4CAF50", duration_ms=1200)
            self._spawn_sparkles(success=True)

            QTimer.singleShot(600, self._show_success_msg)
            return

        # ناموفق
        self.tray.flash("#D32F2F", duration_ms=800)
        print(f"   [CFI-01] ترکیب نامعتبر: {items}")

        # پیام کوتاه
        msg = QMessageBox(self)
        msg.setWindowTitle("نتیجه")
        msg.setText(
            "این ترکیب راه‌حل نداد. دوباره فکر کن؛ "
            "شاید ترکیب متفاوتی لازم باشه."
        )
        msg.setIcon(QMessageBox.Icon.Warning)
        msg.setLayoutDirection(Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft)
        msg.exec()

        # پاک کردن سینی
        self.tray.clear_items()

    def _show_success_msg(self):
        msg = QMessageBox(self)
        msg.setWindowTitle("موفقیت")
        msg.setText(
            f"✓ ترکیب صحیح!\n\n{self.solution_hint}"
        )
        msg.setIcon(QMessageBox.Icon.Information)
        msg.setLayoutDirection(Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft)
        msg.exec()
        QTimer.singleShot(200, self._finalize)

    # ================================================================
    def _spawn_sparkles(self, success: bool = True):
        """تولید sparkles"""
        color = "#4CAF50" if success else "#D32F2F"
        center = self.tray.rect().center()
        tray_pos = self.tray.pos()

        for _ in range(20):
            self._sparkles.append({
                "x": center.x() + random.uniform(-80, 80),
                "y": center.y() + random.uniform(-40, 40),
                "vx": random.uniform(-1.5, 1.5),
                "vy": random.uniform(-2.0, -0.5),
                "life": 1.0,
                "size": random.uniform(2, 5),
                "color": color,
                "offset_x": tray_pos.x(),
                "offset_y": tray_pos.y(),
            })
        self._sparkle_timer.start(30)
        self.update()

    def _tick_sparkles(self):
        alive = []
        for s in self._sparkles:
            s["life"] -= 0.04
            s["x"] += s["vx"]
            s["y"] += s["vy"]
            s["vy"] += 0.08  # گرانش
            if s["life"] > 0:
                alive.append(s)
        self._sparkles = alive
        self.update()
        if not self._sparkles:
            self._sparkle_timer.stop()

    def paintEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        super().paintEvent(event)
        if not self._sparkles:
            return

        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
        painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)

        for s in self._sparkles:
            c = QColor(s["color"])
            c.setAlpha(int(255 * s["life"]))
            painter.setBrush(QBrush(c))
            painter.drawEllipse(
                QPointF(s["x"], s["y"]),
                s["size"] * s["life"],
                s["size"] * s["life"],
            )

        painter.end()

    # ================================================================
    def _finalize(self):
        unique = len(set(self.attempted_combinations))
        total_attempts = len(self.attempted_combinations)
        old_attempts = total_attempts - 1

        result = {
            "solved": self.solved,
            "solution_time_ms": self.solution_time_ms,
            "attempted_combinations": list(
                self.attempted_combinations
            ),
            "total_attempts": total_attempts,
            "unique_attempts": unique,
            "old_solution_attempts": max(0, old_attempts),
        }
        print(f"   [DEBUG] نتیجه CFI-01: {result}")
        self.puzzle_done.emit(result)

"""
ویجت تحلیلگر کوانتومی — اندازه‌گیر صداقت
بر اساس فیلم‌نامه: سه قرائت با اعداد از پیش تعیین‌شده
"""
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QPushButton, QFrame
)
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer, pyqtSignal, QRectF, QPointF
from PyQt6.QtGui import (
    QFont, QPainter, QPen, QBrush, QColor,
    QRadialGradient, QLinearGradient, QPainterPath,
)
import math
import time

FONT_FAMILY = "Vazirmatn"


class QuantumAnalyzerWidget(QWidget):
    """
    ویجت تحلیلگر کوانتومی با سه قرائت از پیش تعیین‌شده
    """
    # سیگنال: (لیست قرائت‌ها، زمان کل به میلی‌ثانیه)
    sequence_completed = pyqtSignal(list, int)

    def __init__(self, readings: list, unit: str = "دامنه موج",
                 button_label: str = "فروپاشی تابع موج",
                 activation_delay_ms: int = 1400,
                 warning_text: str = "", parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.readings = readings
        self.unit = unit
        self.button_label = button_label
        self.activation_delay_ms = activation_delay_ms
        self.warning_text = warning_text

        self.current_index = 0
        self.results = []
        self.is_animating = False
        self.sequence_start_time = 0
        self.sequence_started = False
        self.current_display_number = None

        # رنگ‌های هولوگرام
        self.holo_color = QColor("#4FC3F7")

        # انیمیشن چرخش ذرات — ✅ تایمر به عنوان فرزند ویجت
        self.rotation_angle = 0.0
        self.rotation_timer = QTimer(self)
        self.rotation_timer.timeout.connect(self._rotate_particles)

        # تایمر ظاهر شدن عدد — ✅ تایمر به عنوان فرزند ویجت
        self.reveal_timer = QTimer(self)
        self.reveal_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self.reveal_timer.timeout.connect(self._on_reveal)

        self._setup_ui()
        self.setLayoutDirection(Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    # ساخت UI
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _setup_ui(self):
        main_layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        main_layout.setContentsMargins(40, 15, 40, 15)
        main_layout.setSpacing(12)

        # عنوان
        title = QLabel("تحلیلگر کوانتومی")
        tf = QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 22); tf.setBold(True)
        title.setFont(tf)
        title.setStyleSheet("color: #4FC3F7;")
        title.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        main_layout.addWidget(title)

        # توضیح
        desc = QLabel(
            f"برای اندازه‌گیری ناهنجاری سامانه خنک‌کننده، "
            f"سه بار تحلیلگر را فعال کنید."
        )
        desc.setFont(QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 12))
        desc.setStyleSheet("color: #CCCCCC;")
        desc.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        desc.setWordWrap(True)
        main_layout.addWidget(desc)

        # ناحیه هولوگرام
        self.hologram_widget = _HologramCanvas(self)
        self.hologram_widget.setMinimumHeight(220)
        main_layout.addWidget(self.hologram_widget, stretch=1)

        # سابقه قرائت‌ها
        self.history_frame = QFrame()
        self.history_frame.setStyleSheet("""
            QFrame {
                background-color: rgba(26, 42, 74, 0.7);
                border: 1px solid #4FC3F7;
                border-radius: 8px;
            }
        """)
        history_layout = QHBoxLayout(self.history_frame)
        history_layout.setContentsMargins(15, 8, 15, 8)
        history_layout.setSpacing(15)

        history_lbl = QLabel("سابقه قرائت‌ها:")
        history_lbl.setFont(QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 12))
        history_lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #FFFFFF; border: none;")
        history_layout.addWidget(history_lbl)

        self.history_values = QLabel("—")
        self.history_values.setFont(QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 14, QFont.Weight.Bold))
        self.history_values.setStyleSheet("color: #4FC3F7; border: none;")
        self.history_values.setLayoutDirection(Qt.LayoutDirection.LeftToRight)
        history_layout.addWidget(self.history_values)
        history_layout.addStretch()
        main_layout.addWidget(self.history_frame)

        # وضعیت
        self.status_label = QLabel("")
        self.status_label.setFont(QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 12))
        self.status_label.setStyleSheet("color: #4FC3F7;")
        self.status_label.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        main_layout.addWidget(self.status_label)

        # هشدار
        self.warning_label = QLabel("")
        self.warning_label.setFont(QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 11))
        self.warning_label.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #FF8F00; padding: 8px; border: 1px dashed #FF8F00; "
            "border-radius: 6px; background-color: rgba(255, 143, 0, 0.08);"
        )
        self.warning_label.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        self.warning_label.setWordWrap(True)
        self.warning_label.setVisible(False)
        main_layout.addWidget(self.warning_label)

        # دکمه فعال‌سازی
        self.activate_button = QPushButton(self.button_label)
        btn_font = QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 16); btn_font.setBold(True)
        self.activate_button.setFont(btn_font)
        self.activate_button.setMinimumHeight(58)
        self.activate_button.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        self.activate_button.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton {
                background-color: #2B4A6F;
                color: #FFFFFF;
                border: 2px solid #4FC3F7;
                border-radius: 10px;
                padding: 12px;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                background-color: #4FC3F7;
                color: #0B1D3A;
                border: 2px solid #FFFFFF;
            }
            QPushButton:pressed {
                background-color: #1A2A4A;
                color: #4FC3F7;
            }
            QPushButton:disabled {
                background-color: #1A2A4A;
                color: #888888;
                border: 2px solid #444444;
            }
        """)
        self.activate_button.clicked.connect(self._on_button_clicked)
        main_layout.addWidget(self.activate_button)

        # شروع چرخش ذرات
        self.rotation_timer.start(50)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    # مدیریت کلیک دکمه
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_button_clicked(self):
        if self.current_index >= len(self.readings):
            self._on_finish()
        else:
            self._on_activate()

    def _on_activate(self):
        if self.is_animating:
            return
        if not self.sequence_started:
            self.sequence_start_time = int(time.time() * 1000)
            self.sequence_started = True

        # ✅ صدای پالس کوانتومی
        try:
            from core.audio_manager import get_audio_manager
            get_audio_manager().play_sfx("scan")
        except Exception:
            pass

        self.is_animating = True
        self.activate_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.status_label.setText(
            f"⏳ در حال فروپاشی تابع موج... "
            f"(قرائت {self.current_index + 1} از {len(self.readings)})"
        )
        self.warning_label.setVisible(False)
        self.current_display_number = None
        self.hologram_widget.update()
        self.reveal_timer.start(self.activation_delay_ms)

    def _on_reveal(self):
        if self.current_index >= len(self.readings):
            return

        value = self.readings[self.current_index]
        self.results.append(value)
        self.current_display_number = value

        # ✅ صدای پالس
        try:
            from core.audio_manager import get_audio_manager
            get_audio_manager().play_sfx("scan")
        except Exception:
            pass

        # به‌روزرسانی سابقه
        history_str = "  |  ".join([f"{v:.1f}" for v in self.results])
        self.history_values.setText(history_str)

        self.status_label.setText(
            f"✓ قرائت {self.current_index + 1}: {value:.1f} {self.unit}"
        )
        self.hologram_widget.update()
        self.current_index += 1
        self.is_animating = False

        if self.current_index >= len(self.readings):
            # تمام شد
            avg = sum(self.readings) / len(self.readings)
            self.status_label.setText(
                f"✓ هر سه قرائت انجام شد. میانگین: {avg:.2f} {self.unit}"
            )
            if self.warning_text:
                self.warning_label.setText(f"⚠  {self.warning_text}")
                self.warning_label.setVisible(True)
            self.activate_button.setText("ادامه به گزارش")
            self.activate_button.setEnabled(True)
        else:
            self.activate_button.setText(
                f"فعال‌سازی مجدد ({self.current_index + 1} از {len(self.readings)})"
            )
            self.activate_button.setEnabled(True)

    def _on_finish(self):
        total_time = int(time.time() * 1000) - self.sequence_start_time
        self.rotation_timer.stop()
        self.sequence_completed.emit(self.results.copy(), total_time)

    def _rotate_particles(self):
        self.rotation_angle = (self.rotation_angle + 3) % 360
        self.hologram_widget.update()


# ====================================================================
# صفحه رسم هولوگرام
# ====================================================================
class _HologramCanvas(QWidget):
    """صفحه رسم هولوگرام — نسخه 3.1 با ۱۴ لایه + افکت‌های پیشرفته"""

    def __init__(self, analyzer: "QuantumAnalyzerWidget"):
        super().__init__(analyzer)
        self.analyzer = analyzer
        self.setStyleSheet("background-color: transparent;")

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    @staticmethod
    def _prand(seed: float, frame_seed: float) -> float:
        """pseudo-random [0,1)"""
        x = math.sin(seed * 12.9898 + frame_seed * 78.233) * 43758.5453
        return x - math.floor(x)

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    def paintEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore[reportIncompatibleMethodOverride]
        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)

        w_int = self.width()
        h_int = self.height()
        if w_int < 20 or h_int < 20:
            painter.end()
            return

        w = float(w_int)
        h = float(h_int)
        cx = w / 2.0
        cy = h / 2.0
        radius = min(w, h) / 2.0 - 30.0

        a = self.analyzer

        # ✅ استخراج امن
        ra_raw = getattr(a, "rotation_angle", 0.0)
        rotation_angle: float = (
            float(ra_raw) if ra_raw is not None else 0.0
        )
        is_animating: bool = bool(
            getattr(a, "is_animating", False)
        )
        current_number = getattr(a, "current_display_number", None)
        holo_color = getattr(a, "holo_color", QColor("#4FC3F7"))
        unit_text = str(getattr(a, "unit", ""))

        phase_rad = math.radians(rotation_angle)
        frame_seed = rotation_angle / 360.0

        # ============================================================
        # لایه ۱ — گرادیانت عمیق پس‌زمینه
        # ============================================================
        bg_grad = QRadialGradient(
            QPointF(cx, cy), max(w, h) * 0.75
        )
        bg_grad.setColorAt(0.0, QColor(15, 40, 80))
        bg_grad.setColorAt(0.5, QColor(8, 20, 45))
        bg_grad.setColorAt(1.0, QColor(2, 5, 15))
        painter.fillRect(self.rect(), QBrush(bg_grad))

        # ============================================================
        # لایه ۲ — گرید ریاضی
        # ============================================================
        grid_color = QColor(79, 195, 247, 28)
        painter.setPen(QPen(grid_color, 1))
        step = 36
        x = 0
        while x < w_int:
            painter.drawLine(x, 0, x, h_int)
            x += step
        y = 0
        while y < h_int:
            painter.drawLine(0, y, w_int, y)
            y += step

        main_grid = QColor(79, 195, 247, 60)
        painter.setPen(QPen(main_grid, 1))
        x = 0
        while x < w_int:
            painter.drawLine(x, 0, x, h_int)
            x += step * 4
        y = 0
        while y < h_int:
            painter.drawLine(0, y, w_int, y)
            y += step * 4

        # ============================================================
        # لایه ۳ — براکت‌های گوشه
        # ============================================================
        bracket_col = QColor(79, 195, 247, 200)
        painter.setPen(QPen(bracket_col, 2))
        blen = 28
        m = 12
        painter.drawLine(m, m, m + blen, m)
        painter.drawLine(m, m, m, m + blen)
        painter.drawLine(w_int - m - blen, m, w_int - m, m)
        painter.drawLine(w_int - m, m, w_int - m, m + blen)
        painter.drawLine(m, h_int - m, m + blen, h_int - m)
        painter.drawLine(m, h_int - m - blen, m, h_int - m)
        painter.drawLine(
            w_int - m - blen, h_int - m, w_int - m, h_int - m
        )
        painter.drawLine(
            w_int - m, h_int - m - blen, w_int - m, h_int - m
        )

        painter.setPen(QPen(QColor(79, 195, 247, 100), 1))
        mlen = 14
        mid_x = w_int // 2
        painter.drawLine(mid_x - mlen, m, mid_x + mlen, m)
        painter.drawLine(
            mid_x - mlen, h_int - m, mid_x + mlen, h_int - m
        )

        # ============================================================
        # لایه ۴ — ستون‌های داده
        # ============================================================
        painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
        n_cols = 5
        for i in range(n_cols):
            col_x = w * (0.1 + i * 0.2)
            col_offset = self._prand(i + 100, frame_seed) * h
            n_cells = 7
            for j in range(n_cells):
                cell_y = (col_offset + j * 18) % h
                cell_w = 10.0 + self._prand(
                    i * 10 + j + 200, frame_seed
                ) * 6
                cell_h = 3.0
                alpha = int(
                    50 + self._prand(
                        i * 10 + j + 300, frame_seed
                    ) * 130
                )
                if j == n_cells // 2:
                    alpha = min(220, alpha + 60)
                painter.setBrush(
                    QBrush(QColor(79, 195, 247, alpha))
                )
                painter.drawRect(
                    QRectF(col_x, cell_y, cell_w, cell_h)
                )

        # ============================================================
        # لایه ۵ — حلقه‌ها با Chromatic Aberration
        # ============================================================
        painter.setBrush(Qt.BrushStyle.NoBrush)

        painter.setPen(QPen(QColor(255, 60, 60, 70), 2))
        painter.drawEllipse(QPointF(cx - 1.5, cy), radius, radius)

        painter.setPen(QPen(QColor(60, 60, 255, 70), 2))
        painter.drawEllipse(QPointF(cx + 1.5, cy), radius, radius)

        painter.setPen(QPen(holo_color, 2))
        painter.drawEllipse(QPointF(cx, cy), radius, radius)

        pen_mid = QPen(QColor(79, 195, 247, 150), 1)
        pen_mid.setStyle(Qt.PenStyle.DashLine)
        painter.setPen(pen_mid)
        painter.drawEllipse(
            QPointF(cx, cy), radius * 0.7, radius * 0.7
        )

        painter.setPen(QPen(QColor(79, 195, 247, 100), 1))
        painter.drawEllipse(
            QPointF(cx, cy), radius * 0.4, radius * 0.4
        )

        pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(phase_rad * 2)
        pulse_r = radius * (0.95 + 0.05 * pulse)
        pulse_alpha = int(70 + 70 * pulse)
        painter.setPen(
            QPen(QColor(79, 195, 247, pulse_alpha), 1)
        )
        painter.drawEllipse(QPointF(cx, cy), pulse_r, pulse_r)

        # ============================================================
        # لایه ۶ — قوس‌های انرژی
        # ============================================================
        n_arcs = 4
        for k in range(n_arcs):
            arc_start_deg = rotation_angle * (1 + k * 0.3) + k * 90
            arc_span_deg = 40 + 20 * math.sin(phase_rad + k)
            arc_r = radius * (0.55 + k * 0.12)

            n_samples = 12
            path = QPainterPath()
            first = True
            for s in range(n_samples):
                t = s / (n_samples - 1)
                ang_deg = arc_start_deg + arc_span_deg * t
                ang = math.radians(ang_deg)
                wobble = 4 * math.sin(t * math.pi * 4 + phase_rad * 3)
                px = cx + (arc_r + wobble) * math.cos(ang)
                py = cy + (arc_r + wobble) * math.sin(ang)
                if first:
                    path.moveTo(px, py)
                    first = False
                else:
                    path.lineTo(px, py)

            alpha = int(120 + 80 * math.sin(phase_rad * 2 + k))
            painter.setPen(
                QPen(QColor(79, 195, 247, alpha), 2)
            )
            painter.drawPath(path)

        # ============================================================
        # لایه ۷ — ذرات چرخان
        # ============================================================
        painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
        for i in range(12):
            ang = math.radians(rotation_angle + i * 30)
            r = radius * 0.86
            px = cx + r * math.cos(ang)
            py = cy + r * math.sin(ang)

            glow = QRadialGradient(QPointF(px, py), 14)
            glow.setColorAt(0.0, QColor(79, 195, 247, 240))
            glow.setColorAt(0.5, QColor(79, 195, 247, 120))
            glow.setColorAt(1.0, QColor(79, 195, 247, 0))
            painter.setBrush(QBrush(glow))
            painter.drawEllipse(QPointF(px, py), 14, 14)

            painter.setBrush(QBrush(QColor(200, 240, 255, 255)))
            painter.drawEllipse(QPointF(px, py), 2, 2)

        # ============================================================
        # لایه ۸ — موج‌های فروپاشی
        # ============================================================
        if is_animating:
            for k in range(4):
                wave_r = radius * (0.28 + k * 0.2)
                alpha = max(
                    0, 220 - int((rotation_angle % 120) * 1.8)
                )
                painter.setPen(
                    QPen(QColor(79, 195, 247, alpha), 2)
                )
                painter.setBrush(Qt.BrushStyle.NoBrush)
                painter.drawEllipse(
                    QPointF(cx, cy), wave_r, wave_r
                )

        # ============================================================
        # لایه ۹ — هسته‌ی پالسی
        # ============================================================
        core_pulse = 0.7 + 0.3 * math.sin(phase_rad * 3)
        core_r = 30 * core_pulse

        core_grad = QRadialGradient(QPointF(cx, cy), 70)
        core_grad.setColorAt(0.0, QColor(79, 195, 247, 90))
        core_grad.setColorAt(0.4, QColor(79, 195, 247, 40))
        core_grad.setColorAt(1.0, QColor(79, 195, 247, 0))
        painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
        painter.setBrush(QBrush(core_grad))
        painter.drawEllipse(QPointF(cx, cy), 70, 70)

        painter.setBrush(QBrush(QColor(220, 245, 255, 200)))
        painter.drawEllipse(
            QPointF(cx, cy), core_r * 0.15, core_r * 0.15
        )

        # ============================================================
        # لایه ۱۰ — Waveform پایین
        # ============================================================
        if h_int > 120:
            wave_y = h * 0.88
            wave_color = QColor(79, 195, 247, 140)
            painter.setPen(QPen(wave_color, 1))
            n_points = 60
            amp = 12.0 if is_animating else 5.0
            prev_x: float | None = None
            prev_y: float | None = None
            for i in range(n_points):
                t = i / (n_points - 1)
                px = 20 + t * (w - 40)
                noise_term = (
                    self._prand(i * 3, frame_seed) - 0.5
                ) * amp * 0.4
                py = wave_y + (
                    amp * math.sin(t * math.pi * 8 + phase_rad * 6)
                    + amp * 0.4 * math.sin(
                        t * math.pi * 20 + phase_rad * 10
                    )
                    + noise_term
                )
                if prev_x is not None and prev_y is not None:
                    painter.drawLine(
                        QPointF(prev_x, prev_y),
                        QPointF(px, py),
                    )
                prev_x = px
                prev_y = py

        # ============================================================
        # لایه ۱۱ — خط اسکن
        # ============================================================
        scan_y = (rotation_angle * 2) % (h + 60) - 30
        scan_grad = QLinearGradient(0, scan_y - 15, 0, scan_y + 15)
        scan_grad.setColorAt(0.0, QColor(79, 195, 247, 0))
        scan_grad.setColorAt(0.5, QColor(79, 195, 247, 100))
        scan_grad.setColorAt(1.0, QColor(79, 195, 247, 0))
        painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
        painter.setBrush(QBrush(scan_grad))
        painter.drawRect(
            QRectF(0, scan_y - 15, w, 30)
        )

        # ============================================================
        # لایه ۱۲ — نویز نقطه‌ای
        # ============================================================
        for i in range(24):
            nx = self._prand(i * 17 + 1, frame_seed) * w
            ny = self._prand(i * 23 + 2, frame_seed) * h
            alpha = int(20 + self._prand(i + 500, frame_seed) * 100)
            painter.setBrush(QBrush(QColor(79, 195, 247, alpha)))
            painter.drawEllipse(QPointF(nx, ny), 1, 1)

        # ============================================================
        # لایه ۱۳ — نمایش عدد / متن انتظار
        # ============================================================
        if current_number is not None:
            halo = QRadialGradient(QPointF(cx, cy), 130)
            halo.setColorAt(0.0, QColor(79, 195, 247, 65))
            halo.setColorAt(1.0, QColor(79, 195, 247, 0))
            painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
            painter.setBrush(QBrush(halo))
            painter.drawEllipse(QPointF(cx, cy), 130, 130)

            bg_rect = QRectF(cx - 85, cy - 38, 170, 76)
            painter.setBrush(QBrush(QColor(11, 29, 58, 230)))
            painter.drawRoundedRect(bg_rect, 12, 12)

            painter.setPen(QPen(holo_color, 2))
            painter.setBrush(Qt.BrushStyle.NoBrush)
            painter.drawRoundedRect(bg_rect, 12, 12)

            painter.setPen(QColor("#FFFFFF"))
            painter.setFont(
                QFont("Vazirmatn", 30, QFont.Weight.Bold)
            )
            painter.drawText(
                bg_rect,
                int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter),
                f"{float(current_number):.1f}",
            )

            painter.setPen(QColor("#4FC3F7"))
            painter.setFont(QFont("Vazirmatn", 11))
            painter.drawText(
                QRectF(cx - 85, cy + 38, 170, 20),
                int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter),
                unit_text,
            )
        else:
            wait_pulse = 0.55 + 0.45 * math.sin(phase_rad * 3)
            wait_alpha = int(140 + 115 * wait_pulse)
            painter.setPen(QColor(79, 195, 247, wait_alpha))
            painter.setFont(QFont("Vazirmatn", 14))
            painter.drawText(
                QRectF(cx - 130, cy - 15, 260, 30),
                int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter),
                "●  آماده فروپاشی  ●",
            )

        # ============================================================
        # لایه ۱۴ — برچسب‌های HUD
        # ============================================================
        painter.setFont(
            QFont("Consolas", 8, QFont.Weight.Bold)
        )
        painter.setPen(QColor(79, 195, 247, 140))

        # ✅ استفاده از QRectF — نوع-safe
        painter.drawText(
            QRectF(20, 12, 130, 20),
            int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft
                | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter),
            "SCAN.ACTIVE",
        )
        painter.drawText(
            QRectF(w - 130, 12, 120, 20),
            int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight
                | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter),
            "MODE.HOLO_01",
        )
        painter.drawText(
            QRectF(20, h - 30, 120, 20),
            int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft
                | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter),
            f"PHASE.{int(rotation_angle):03d}",
        )

        if is_animating:
            status = "SIGNAL.IN_PROGRESS"
        elif current_number is not None:
            status = "SIGNAL.LOCKED"
        else:
            status = "SIGNAL.IDLE"
        painter.drawText(
            QRectF(w - 170, h - 30, 160, 20),
            int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight
                | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter),
            status,
        )

        # ============================================================
        # ✅ لایه‌های جدید — افکت‌های پیشرفته
        # ============================================================

        # لایه ۱۵ — Reticle (نشانگر مرکزی)
        reticle_alpha = int(120 + 60 * math.sin(phase_rad * 4))
        painter.setPen(QPen(QColor(79, 195, 247, reticle_alpha), 1))
        painter.setBrush(Qt.BrushStyle.NoBrush)
        reticle_len = 20
        reticle_gap = 55
        # چهار خط کوتاه اطراف مرکز
        painter.drawLine(
            QPointF(cx, cy - reticle_gap),
            QPointF(cx, cy - reticle_gap + reticle_len),
        )
        painter.drawLine(
            QPointF(cx, cy + reticle_gap),
            QPointF(cx, cy + reticle_gap - reticle_len),
        )
        painter.drawLine(
            QPointF(cx - reticle_gap, cy),
            QPointF(cx - reticle_gap + reticle_len, cy),
        )
        painter.drawLine(
            QPointF(cx + reticle_gap, cy),
            QPointF(cx + reticle_gap - reticle_len, cy),
        )

        # لایه ۱۶ — گوشه‌های براکت داخلی
        inner_col = QColor(79, 195, 247, 90)
        painter.setPen(QPen(inner_col, 1))
        inner_r = radius * 0.92
        # چهار قوس کوتاه در گوشه‌های دایره
        for k in range(4):
            ang_start = math.radians(k * 90 + 45)
            ang_end = math.radians(k * 90 + 45 + 15)
            path2 = QPainterPath()
            path2.moveTo(
                cx + inner_r * math.cos(ang_start),
                cy + inner_r * math.sin(ang_start),
            )
            n_sub = 6
            for s in range(1, n_sub + 1):
                t = s / n_sub
                ang = ang_start + (ang_end - ang_start) * t
                path2.lineTo(
                    cx + inner_r * math.cos(ang),
                    cy + inner_r * math.sin(ang),
                )
            painter.drawPath(path2)

        # لایه ۱۷ — Data particles (ذرات داده‌ی پراکنده)
        painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
        for i in range(8):
            seed_val = i * 37 + 900
            angle = self._prand(seed_val, frame_seed) * 2 * math.pi
            r_factor = 0.5 + 0.45 * self._prand(
                seed_val + 1, frame_seed
            )
            pr = radius * r_factor
            px = cx + pr * math.cos(angle + phase_rad)
            py = cy + pr * math.sin(angle + phase_rad)
            sz = 1.5 + self._prand(seed_val + 2, frame_seed) * 2
            alpha = int(60 + self._prand(seed_val + 3, frame_seed) * 120)
            painter.setBrush(QBrush(QColor(200, 240, 255, alpha)))
            painter.drawEllipse(QPointF(px, py), sz, sz)

        # ============================================================
        # ✅ لایه ۱۸ — Energy Trails (خطوط انرژی بین ذرات)
        # ============================================================
        # ذرات نزدیک به هم را با خطوط ظریف وصل می‌کنیم
        particles = []
        for i in range(12):
            ang = math.radians(rotation_angle + i * 30)
            r = radius * 0.86
            particles.append((
                cx + r * math.cos(ang),
                cy + r * math.sin(ang),
            ))

        painter.setPen(QPen(QColor(79, 195, 247, 35), 1))
        painter.setBrush(Qt.BrushStyle.NoBrush)
        for i in range(len(particles)):
            for j in range(i + 1, len(particles)):
                p1 = particles[i]
                p2 = particles[j]
                dist = math.hypot(p1[0] - p2[0], p1[1] - p2[1])
                if dist < radius * 0.7:
                    alpha_link = int(
                        80 * (1 - dist / (radius * 0.7))
                    )
                    painter.setPen(
                        QPen(QColor(79, 195, 247, alpha_link), 1)
                    )
                    painter.drawLine(
                        QPointF(p1[0], p1[1]),
                        QPointF(p2[0], p2[1]),
                    )

        # ============================================================
        # ✅ لایه ۱۹ — Central Ripple (موج مرکزی زنده)
        # ============================================================
        ripple_count = 3
        for k in range(ripple_count):
            phase_offset = k * 0.33
            ripple_progress = (
                (rotation_angle * 0.01 + phase_offset) % 1.0
            )
            ripple_r = ripple_progress * radius * 0.9
            ripple_alpha = int(90 * (1 - ripple_progress))
            painter.setPen(
                QPen(QColor(79, 195, 247, ripple_alpha), 1)
            )
            painter.setBrush(Qt.BrushStyle.NoBrush)
            painter.drawEllipse(
                QPointF(cx, cy), ripple_r, ripple_r
            )

        # ============================================================
        # ✅ لایه ۲۰ — Central HUD Meter (نوار افقی پایین)
        # ============================================================
        if h_int > 130:
            meter_y = h - 40
            meter_w = w * 0.5
            meter_x = (w - meter_w) / 2
            meter_h = 4

            # پس‌زمینه
            painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
            painter.setBrush(
                QBrush(QColor(79, 195, 247, 40))
            )
            painter.drawRect(
                QRectF(meter_x, meter_y, meter_w, meter_h)
            )

            # مقدار متغیر
            fill = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(phase_rad * 2)
            fill_w = meter_w * fill
            painter.setBrush(
                QBrush(QColor(79, 195, 247, 180))
            )
            painter.drawRect(
                QRectF(meter_x, meter_y, fill_w, meter_h)
            )

            # نشانگر
            marker_x = meter_x + fill_w
            painter.setBrush(
                QBrush(QColor(220, 245, 255, 240))
            )
            painter.drawEllipse(
                QPointF(marker_x, meter_y + meter_h / 2),
                3, 3
            )

        painter.end()

// File: truthline_pyqt/widgets/radar_chart.py

"""
ویجت نمودار راداری برای نمایش پروفایل شایستگی
=====================================
ویژگی‌ها:
- رسم با QPainter (سریع و حرفه‌ای)
- پشتیبانی از ۴ شایستگی
- نمایش نمرات و برچسب‌ها با فونت Vazirmatn
- طراحی متعادل با شبکه‌بندی واضح

نسخه: 2.1.0
"""
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QWidget
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QRectF, QPointF
from PyQt6.QtGui import (
    QPainter, QPen, QBrush, QColor, QFont, QPolygonF
)
import math


class RadarChart(QWidget):
    """ویجت نمودار راداری برای نمایش پروفایل شایستگی"""

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)

        # تنظیمات
        self.setMinimumSize(400, 400)

        # داده‌ها
        self.competencies: list[str] = [
            "صداقت و یکپارچگی",
            "قابلیت اعتماد",
            "حل مسئله",
            "مسئولیت‌پذیری",
        ]
        self.scores: list[float] = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]  # بین ۰ تا ۱۰۰

        # رنگ‌ها
        self.bg_color = QColor("#0B1D3A")
        self.grid_color = QColor("#2B4A6F")
        self.axis_color = QColor("#3A5A7F")
        self.data_color = QColor("#4FC3F7")
        self.data_fill_color = QColor(79, 195, 247, 70)
        self.point_color = QColor("#FFFFFF")
        self.text_color = QColor("#FFFFFF")
        self.score_color = QColor("#FF8F00")

        print("✓ RadarChart راه‌اندازی شد")

    def set_scores(self, scores: list[float]):
        """
        تنظیم نمرات شایستگی‌ها

        Args:
            scores: لیست ۴ نمره بین ۰ تا ۱۰۰
        """
        if len(scores) != 4:
            print(f"⚠️ هشدار: انتظار ۴ نمره داشتیم، اما {len(scores)} دریافت شد")
            return

        # محدود کردن نمرات به بازه ۰ تا ۱۰۰
        self.scores = [max(0.0, min(100.0, float(s))) for s in scores]
        self.update()

    def paintEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore[reportIncompatibleMethodOverride]
        """رویداد رسم ویجت"""
        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)

        # محاسبه مرکز و شعاع
        center_x: float = self.width() / 2
        center_y: float = self.height() / 2
        radius: float = min(self.width(), self.height()) / 2 - 70

        # اگر فضا خیلی کم است، رسم نکن
        if radius < 50:
            return

        # ========================================
        # رسم پس‌زمینه
        # ========================================
        painter.fillRect(self.rect(), self.bg_color)

        # ========================================
        # رسم شبکه (Grid) — پنج حلقه هم‌مرکز
        # ========================================
        grid_pen = QPen(self.grid_color, 1, Qt.PenStyle.DashLine)
        painter.setPen(grid_pen)
        painter.setBrush(Qt.BrushStyle.NoBrush)

        for level in range(1, 6):
            r = radius * level / 5
            painter.drawEllipse(QPointF(center_x, center_y), r, r)

        # ========================================
        # رسم خطوط شعاعی (چهار محور)
        # ========================================
        num_axes = len(self.competencies)
        angle_step = 2 * math.pi / num_axes

        axis_pen = QPen(self.axis_color, 1, Qt.PenStyle.SolidLine)
        painter.setPen(axis_pen)

        for i in range(num_axes):
            angle = i * angle_step - math.pi / 2  # شروع از بالا
            x = center_x + radius * math.cos(angle)
            y = center_y + radius * math.sin(angle)
            painter.drawLine(
                QPointF(center_x, center_y),
                QPointF(x, y)
            )

        # ========================================
        # ساخت نقاط داده
        # ========================================
        points: list[QPointF] = []
        for i, score in enumerate(self.scores):
            angle = i * angle_step - math.pi / 2
            r = radius * score / 100
            x = center_x + r * math.cos(angle)
            y = center_y + r * math.sin(angle)
            points.append(QPointF(x, y))

        # ========================================
        # رسم ناحیه پر شده
        # ========================================
        polygon = QPolygonF(points)
        painter.setBrush(QBrush(self.data_fill_color))
        painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
        painter.drawPolygon(polygon)

        # ========================================
        # رسم خطوط دور ناحیه
        # ========================================
        outline_pen = QPen(self.data_color, 3)
        painter.setPen(outline_pen)
        painter.setBrush(Qt.BrushStyle.NoBrush)
        painter.drawPolygon(polygon)

        # ========================================
        # رسم نقاط (vertices)
        # ========================================
        painter.setBrush(QBrush(self.point_color))
        painter.setPen(QPen(self.data_color, 2))
        for point in points:
            painter.drawEllipse(point, 6, 6)

        # ========================================
        # رسم برچسب‌ها و نمرات
        # ========================================
        label_font = QFont("Vazirmatn", 12, QFont.Weight.Bold)
        score_font = QFont("Vazirmatn", 13, QFont.Weight.Bold)

        for i, (comp, score) in enumerate(zip(self.competencies, self.scores)):
            angle = i * angle_step - math.pi / 2
            label_r = radius + 45
            x = center_x + label_r * math.cos(angle)
            y = center_y + label_r * math.sin(angle)

            # برچسب شایستگی
            painter.setPen(self.text_color)
            painter.setFont(label_font)
            painter.drawText(
                QRectF(x - 80, y - 22, 160, 22),
                Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter,
                comp,
            )

            # نمره
            painter.setPen(self.score_color)
            painter.setFont(score_font)
            painter.drawText(
                QRectF(x - 50, y, 100, 22),
                Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter,
                f"{int(score)}",
            )

        painter.end()

# نوار پیشرفت ۲۰ سلولی

class _LogProgressBar(QWidget):
    """نوار پیشرفت با ۲۰ سلول کوچک"""

    def __init__(self, total: int = 20, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.total = max(1, total)
        self._filled = 0
        self._auto = 0  # تعداد خودکار (کم‌رنگ)

        self.setMinimumHeight(20)
        self.setMaximumHeight(20)
        self.setStyleSheet("background: transparent;")

    def set_filled(self, count: int, auto: int = 0):
        self._filled = max(0, min(self.total, count))
        self._auto = max(0, min(self.total - self._filled, auto))
        self.update()

    def paintEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)

        w = self.width()
        h = self.height()
        gap = 2
        cell_w = max(2.0, (w - gap * (self.total - 1)) / self.total)
        radius = 2.0

        for i in range(self.total):
            x = i * (cell_w + gap)
            rect = QRectF(x, 4, cell_w, h - 8)

            if i < self._filled:
                # بررسی‌شده‌ی واقعی
                color = QColor(76, 175, 80)
            elif i < self._filled + self._auto:
                # خودکار (نصفه)
                color = QColor(255, 143, 0, 180)
            else:
                # باقی‌مانده
                color = QColor(26, 42, 74)

            painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
            painter.setBrush(QBrush(color))
            painter.drawRoundedRect(rect, radius, radius)

        painter.end()

        # ---------- ناحیه اسکرول با ۲۰ لاگ ----------
        scroll_area = QScrollArea()
        scroll_area.setWidgetResizable(True)
        scroll_area.setFrameShape(QFrame.Shape.NoFrame)
        scroll_area.setStyleSheet(
            "QScrollArea { background-color: #0B1D3A; border: none; }"
        )

        content = QWidget()
        content.setStyleSheet("background-color: #0B1D3A;")
        content_layout = QVBoxLayout(content)
        content_layout.setContentsMargins(4, 4, 4, 4)
        content_layout.setSpacing(4)

        for i in range(self.TOTAL_ROWS):
            row = self._create_log_row(i)
            content_layout.addWidget(row)

        content_layout.addStretch()
        scroll_area.setWidget(content)
        self._scroll_area = scroll_area
        main_layout.addWidget(scroll_area, stretch=1)

        # ---------- دکمه ثبت ----------
        self.submit_btn = QPushButton("پایان بررسی و ثبت گزارش")
        sbf = QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 14)
        sbf.setBold(True)
        self.submit_btn.setFont(sbf)
        self.submit_btn.setMinimumHeight(48)
        self.submit_btn.setCursor(
            Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor
        )
        self.submit_btn.setFocusPolicy(
            Qt.FocusPolicy.NoFocus
        )
        self.submit_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.submit_btn.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton {
                background-color: #2B4A6F;
                color: #FFFFFF;
                border: 2px solid #4FC3F7;
                border-radius: 8px;
                padding: 10px;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                background-color: #4FC3F7;
                color: #0B1D3A;
            }
            QPushButton:disabled {
                background-color: #1A2A4A;
                color: #666666;
                border: 2px solid #444444;
            }
        """)
        self.submit_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_submit)
        main_layout.addWidget(self.submit_btn)

        # هایلایت ردیف اول
        self._highlight_next_row()

    # ================================================================
    def _create_log_row(self, index):
        frame = QFrame()
        frame.setStyleSheet(self._row_style_pending())
        frame.setMinimumHeight(46)

        layout = QHBoxLayout(frame)
        layout.setContentsMargins(10, 4, 10, 4)
        layout.setSpacing(10)

        num_lbl = QLabel(f"#{index + 1:02d}")
        num_lbl.setFont(QFont("Arial", 10, QFont.Weight.Bold))
        num_lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #4FC3F7; border: none;")
        num_lbl.setFixedWidth(38)
        layout.addWidget(num_lbl)

        code_lbl = QLabel(self._make_log_text(index))
        code_lbl.setFont(QFont("Consolas", 9))
        code_lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #B0BEC5; border: none;")
        code_lbl.setLayoutDirection(Qt.LayoutDirection.LeftToRight)
        layout.addWidget(code_lbl, 1)

        status_lbl = QLabel("در انتظار")
        status_lbl.setFont(QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 10))
        status_lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #666666; border: none;")
        status_lbl.setFixedWidth(100)
        layout.addWidget(status_lbl)
        frame.setProperty("status_lbl", status_lbl)

        btn = QPushButton("بررسی")
        btn.setFont(QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 11, QFont.Weight.Bold))
        btn.setMinimumHeight(32)
        btn.setMinimumWidth(100)
        btn.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        btn.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.NoFocus)
        btn.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton {
                background-color: #2B4A6F;
                color: #FFFFFF;
                border: 2px solid #4FC3F7;
                border-radius: 6px;
                padding: 4px;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                background-color: #4FC3F7;
                color: #0B1D3A;
            }
            QPushButton:disabled {
                background-color: #1A2A4A;
                color: #666666;
                border: 2px solid #444444;
            }
        """)
        btn.clicked.connect(lambda _, i=index: self._on_check_row(i))
        layout.addWidget(btn)

        self.row_frames[index] = frame
        self.row_buttons[index] = btn
        self.row_status_labels[index] = status_lbl
        self.row_status[index] = "pending"

        return frame

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _row_style_pending(self) -> str:
        return """
            QFrame {
                background-color: rgba(26, 42, 74, 0.6);
                border: 1px solid #2B4A6F;
                border-radius: 6px;
            }
        """

    def _row_style_next(self) -> str:
        return """
            QFrame {
                background-color: rgba(79, 195, 247, 0.10);
                border: 2px solid #4FC3F7;
                border-radius: 6px;
            }
        """

    def _row_style_done_honest(self) -> str:
        return """
            QFrame {
                background-color: rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.10);
                border: 1px solid #4CAF50;
                border-radius: 6px;
            }
        """

    def _row_style_done_auto(self) -> str:
        return """
            QFrame {
                background-color: rgba(255, 143, 0, 0.10);
                border: 1px solid #FF8F00;
                border-radius: 6px;
            }
        """

    def _make_log_text(self, index):
        patterns = [
            "LOG.SYS bus_temp={}°C status=OK",
            "LOG.SYS gas_press={}kPa status=OK",
            "LOG.SYS rad_meter={}mSv status=OK",
            "LOG.SYS cpu_load={}% status=OK",
        ]
        p = patterns[index % len(patterns)]
        val = 20 + (index * 7) % 60
        return p.format(val)

    # ================================================================
    # هایلایت ردیف بعدی
    # ================================================================
    def _highlight_next_row(self):
        """ردیف بعدی که باید بررسی شود را هایلایت می‌کند"""
        next_idx = None
        for i in range(self.TOTAL_ROWS):
            if self.row_status.get(i) == "pending":
                next_idx = i
                break

        for i in range(self.TOTAL_ROWS):
            if self.row_status.get(i) != "pending":
                continue
            frame = self.row_frames.get(i)
            if frame is None:
                continue
            if i == next_idx:
                frame.setStyleSheet(self._row_style_next())
            else:
                frame.setStyleSheet(self._row_style_pending())

    # ================================================================
    # بررسی ردیف
    # ================================================================
    def _on_check_row(self, index):
        if self.cheat_used or self.is_done:
            return
        if self._spinner_active:
            return
        if self.row_status.get(index) != "pending":
            return

        # صدای کلیک
        try:
            from core.audio_manager import get_audio_manager
            get_audio_manager().play_sfx("click")
        except Exception:
            pass

        # شروع اسپینر
        self._start_spinner(index)

    def _start_spinner(self, index):
        """شروع انیمیشن اسپینر روی دکمه‌ی این ردیف"""
        self._spinner_active = True
        self._spinner_target = index
        self._spinner_index = 0

        btn = self.row_buttons.get(index)
        if btn is None:
            self._finish_check(index)
            return

        btn.setEnabled(False)
        btn.setText("◐ در حال بررسی")
        self._spinner_timer.start(120)

        # ✅ تایمر اتمام اسپینر — این خط قبلاً نبود و باعث
        #    فریز می‌شد: اسپینر تا ابد می‌چرخید و _finish_check
        #    هیچ‌وقت صدا زده نمی‌شد
        QTimer.singleShot(self.SPINNER_MS, self._finish_spinner)

    def _tick_spinner(self):
        self._spinner_index = (
            self._spinner_index + 1
        ) % len(self._spinner_chars)
        char = self._spinner_chars[self._spinner_index]
        btn = self.row_buttons.get(self._spinner_target)
        if btn is not None:
            btn.setText(f"{char} در حال بررسی")

    def _finish_spinner(self):
        """
        ✅ پایان اسپینر — از طریق QTimer.singleShot صدا زده
        می‌شود. اگر قبلاً تمام شده، نادیده می‌گیرد.
        """
        if not self._spinner_active:
            return
        index = self._spinner_target
        self._finish_check(index)

    def _finish_check(self, index):
        """اتمام اسپینر و علامت‌گذاری ردیف"""
        self._spinner_timer.stop()
        self._spinner_active = False

        self._mark_row(index, "honest")
        self.checked_rows.add(index)
        self._update_progress()
        self._highlight_next_row()

        # وسوسه‌ها
        count = len(self.checked_rows)
        for temp in TEMPTATIONS:
            if (
                temp["trigger"] == count
                and temp["trigger"] not in self.temptations_shown
            ):
                self.temptations_shown.append(temp["trigger"])
                QTimer.singleShot(
                    400,
                    lambda t=temp: self._show_temptation(t),
                )
                break

    def _mark_row(self, index, status):
        self.row_status[index] = status
        frame = self.row_frames[index]
        lbl = self.row_status_labels.get(index)
        btn = self.row_buttons[index]

        if status == "honest":
            if lbl is not None:
                lbl.setText("✓ بررسی شد")
                lbl.setStyleSheet(
                    "color: #4CAF50; border: none;"
                )
            frame.setStyleSheet(self._row_style_done_honest())
        elif status == "auto":
            if lbl is not None:
                lbl.setText("◐ خودکار")
                lbl.setStyleSheet(
                    "color: #FF8F00; border: none;"
                )
            frame.setStyleSheet(self._row_style_done_auto())

        btn.setEnabled(False)
        btn.setText("✓")

    # ================================================================
    def _update_progress(self):
        count = len(self.checked_rows)
        auto_count = sum(
            1 for s in self.row_status.values() if s == "auto"
        )
        self.progress_bar.set_filled(
            count - auto_count, auto_count
        )
        self.progress_label.setText(
            f"{count} از {self.TOTAL_ROWS}"
        )

        if count >= self.TOTAL_ROWS:
            self.submit_btn.setEnabled(True)
            self.submit_btn.setText("✓ پایان و ثبت گزارش")

    # ================================================================
    # وسوسه
    # ================================================================
    def _show_temptation(self, temp: dict):
        if self.is_done or self.cheat_used:
            return

        msg = QMessageBox(self)
        msg.setWindowTitle("پیام فوری")
        msg.setText(temp["npc_message"])
        msg.setIcon(QMessageBox.Icon.Question)
        msg.setLayoutDirection(Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft)

        btn_continue = msg.addButton(
            temp["continue_label"],
            QMessageBox.ButtonRole.AcceptRole,
        )
        btn_shortcut = msg.addButton(
            temp["shortcut_label"],
            QMessageBox.ButtonRole.RejectRole,
        )
        msg.setDefaultButton(btn_continue)
        msg.exec()

        if msg.clickedButton() == btn_shortcut:
            self._use_shortcut(
                trigger_row=temp["trigger"],
                mood=temp["mood"],
            )
        else:
            self.temptations_rejected += 1
            print(
                f"   [TC-01] وسوسه‌ی مرحله {temp['trigger']} "
                f"رد شد (تعداد رد: {self.temptations_rejected})"
            )

    def _use_shortcut(self, trigger_row: int, mood: str):
        """بازیکن تسلیم وسوسه شد — خودکار جلو می‌رود"""
        self.cheat_used = True
        self.cheat_trigger_row = trigger_row
        self.temptations_accepted += 1

        remaining = [
            i for i in range(self.TOTAL_ROWS)
            if self.row_status[i] == "pending"
        ]
        for i in remaining:
            self._mark_row(i, "auto")
            self.checked_rows.add(i)

        self._update_progress()
        self._highlight_next_row()
        print(
            f"   [TC-01] بازیکن در مرحله {trigger_row} تسلیم شد "
            f"(mood={mood})"
        )

        # ✅ خودکار ثبت گزارش بعد از ۱.۲ ثانیه
        #    (به بازیکن فرصت دیدن وضعیت را می‌دهد)
        self.submit_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.submit_btn.setText("✓ در حال ثبت گزارش...")
        QTimer.singleShot(1200, self._auto_submit)

    def _auto_submit(self):
        """ثبت خودکار بعد از تسلیم شدن به وسوسه"""
        if self.is_done:
            return
        print("   [TC-01] ثبت خودکار گزارش پس از تسلیم")
        self._on_submit()

    # ================================================================
    def _on_submit(self):
        if self.is_done:
            return
        self.is_done = True

        total_time = int(time.time() * 1000) - self.start_time
        honest = sum(
            1 for s in self.row_status.values() if s == "honest"
        )
        auto = sum(
            1 for s in self.row_status.values() if s == "auto"
        )

        result = {
            "total_rows": self.TOTAL_ROWS,
            "honest_checked": honest,
            "auto_checked": auto,
            "completion_rate": round(
                honest / self.TOTAL_ROWS, 3
            ),
            "cheat_used": self.cheat_used,
            "cheat_trigger_row": self.cheat_trigger_row,
            "temptations_shown": len(self.temptations_shown),
            "temptations_rejected": self.temptations_rejected,
            "temptations_accepted": self.temptations_accepted,
            "rejected_temptation": (
                self.temptations_rejected > 0
                and self.temptations_accepted == 0
            ),
            "total_time_ms": total_time,
        }
        print(f"   [DEBUG] نتیجه TC-01: {result}")
        self.task_done.emit(result)

"""
ویجت تخصیص منابع اضطراری — SPA-02
نسخه 4.0 — با Drag & Drop واقعی

تغییرات نسخه 4.0:
- منابع به‌صورت کارت‌های قابل کشیدن
- بخش‌ها به‌عنوان Drop target
- تایمر Sticky در بالا (همیشه در دید)
- بدون خطوط ارتباطی بین بخش‌ها

نسخه: 4.0.0
"""
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QPushButton,
    QFrame, QProgressBar, QMessageBox, QGridLayout, QScrollArea
)
from PyQt6.QtCore import (
    Qt, QTimer, pyqtSignal, QMimeData, QPoint
)
from PyQt6.QtGui import (
    QDrag, QFont, QPainter, QPixmap
)
import time

FONT_FAMILY = "Vazirmatn"
MIME_TYPE_RESOURCE = "application/x-truthline-resource-id"

RESOURCE_ICONS = {
    "battery": "🔋",
    "oxygen": "💊",
    "software": "💻",
}
RESOURCE_NAMES = {
    "battery": "باتری پر قدرت",
    "oxygen": "کپسول اکسیژن",
    "software": "کیت نرم‌افزاری",
}


# ====================================================================
# کارت منبع قابل کشیدن
# ====================================================================
class _DraggableResource(QFrame):
    """کارت منبع که می‌توان آن را کشید"""

    def __init__(self, resource: dict, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.resource_id = resource["id"]
        self._drag_start: QPoint | None = None

        self.setObjectName("resourceCard")
        self._apply_available_style()
        self.setMinimumHeight(64)
        self.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.OpenHandCursor)

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(12, 8, 12, 8)
        layout.setSpacing(10)

        icon = RESOURCE_ICONS.get(self.resource_id, "●")
        name = RESOURCE_NAMES.get(
            self.resource_id, resource.get("name", "")
        )

        self.icon_lbl = QLabel(icon)
        self.icon_lbl.setFont(QFont("Arial", 22))
        self.icon_lbl.setStyleSheet("border: none;")
        self.icon_lbl.setAttribute(
            Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, True
        )
        layout.addWidget(self.icon_lbl)

        self.name_lbl = QLabel(name)
        self.name_lbl.setFont(
            QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 12, QFont.Weight.Bold)
        )
        self.name_lbl.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #FFFFFF; border: none;"
        )
        self.name_lbl.setLayoutDirection(
            Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft
        )
        self.name_lbl.setAttribute(
            Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, True
        )
        layout.addWidget(self.name_lbl, 1)

        self.hint_lbl = QLabel("برای تخصیص بکشید")
        self.hint_lbl.setFont(QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 9))
        self.hint_lbl.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #90A4AE; border: none; "
            "font-style: italic;"
        )
        self.hint_lbl.setAttribute(
            Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, True
        )
        layout.addWidget(self.hint_lbl)

    def _apply_available_style(self):
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QFrame#resourceCard {
                background-color: #1A2A4A;
                border: 2px solid #4FC3F7;
                border-radius: 10px;
            }
            QFrame#resourceCard:hover {
                background-color: #2B4A6F;
                border: 2px solid #FFFFFF;
            }
        """)

    def set_used(self, used: bool):
        """وقتی منبع تخصیص یافت"""
        if used:
            self.setStyleSheet("""
                QFrame#resourceCard {
                    background-color: rgba(11, 29, 58, 0.5);
                    border: 2px solid #444444;
                    border-radius: 10px;
                }
            """)
            self.name_lbl.setStyleSheet(
                "color: #666666; border: none; "
                "text-decoration: line-through;"
            )
            self.hint_lbl.setText("استفاده‌شده")
            self.hint_lbl.setStyleSheet(
                "color: #666666; border: none; "
                "font-style: italic;"
            )
            self.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.ForbiddenCursor)
        else:
            self._apply_available_style()
            self.name_lbl.setStyleSheet(
                "color: #FFFFFF; border: none;"
            )
            self.hint_lbl.setText("برای تخصیص بکشید")
            self.hint_lbl.setStyleSheet(
                "color: #90A4AE; border: none; "
                "font-style: italic;"
            )
            self.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.OpenHandCursor)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def mousePressEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        if event.button() == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
            self._drag_start = event.pos()
            self.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.ClosedHandCursor)
        super().mousePressEvent(event)

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        if self.cursor().shape() != Qt.CursorShape.ForbiddenCursor:
            self.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.OpenHandCursor)
        self._drag_start = None
        super().mouseReleaseEvent(event)

    def mouseMoveEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        if self._drag_start is None:
            return
        if not (event.buttons() & Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton):
            return
        if self.cursor().shape() == Qt.CursorShape.ForbiddenCursor:
            return

        dist = (event.pos() - self._drag_start).manhattanLength()
        if dist < 8:
            return

        drag = QDrag(self)
        mime = QMimeData()
        mime.setData(
            MIME_TYPE_RESOURCE, self.resource_id.encode("utf-8")
        )
        drag.setMimeData(mime)

        pixmap = self.grab()
        faded = QPixmap(pixmap.size())
        faded.fill(Qt.GlobalColor.transparent)
        painter = QPainter(faded)
        painter.setOpacity(0.85)
        painter.drawPixmap(0, 0, pixmap)
        painter.end()
        drag.setPixmap(faded)
        drag.setHotSpot(event.pos())

        drag.exec(Qt.DropAction.MoveAction)
        if self.cursor().shape() != Qt.CursorShape.ForbiddenCursor:
            self.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.OpenHandCursor)

        self.clear_btn = QPushButton("✕")
        self.clear_btn.setFont(QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 12))
        self.clear_btn.setFixedSize(26, 26)
        self.clear_btn.setCursor(
            Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor
        )
        self.clear_btn.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.NoFocus)
        self.clear_btn.setVisible(False)
        self.clear_btn.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton {
                background-color: transparent;
                color: #D32F2F;
                border: 1px solid #D32F2F;
                border-radius: 13px;
                padding: 0;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                background-color: #D32F2F;
                color: #FFFFFF;
            }
        """)
        self.clear_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_clear_clicked)
        alloc_row.addWidget(self.clear_btn)

        layout.addLayout(alloc_row)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _apply_style(self):
        if self._is_highlighted:
            self.setStyleSheet("""
                QFrame#sectionCard {
                    background-color: rgba(79, 195, 247, 0.20);
                    border: 2px solid #FFFFFF;
                    border-radius: 8px;
                }
            """)
        elif self._allocated_resource is not None:
            self.setStyleSheet("""
                QFrame#sectionCard {
                    background-color: rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.10);
                    border: 2px solid #4CAF50;
                    border-radius: 8px;
                }
            """)
        else:
            self.setStyleSheet("""
                QFrame#sectionCard {
                    background-color: rgba(26, 42, 74, 0.7);
                    border: 2px solid #4FC3F7;
                    border-radius: 8px;
                }
            """)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def get_allocated_resource(self) -> str | None:
        return self._allocated_resource

    def set_allocated(self, resource_id: str):
        self._allocated_resource = resource_id
        icon = RESOURCE_ICONS.get(resource_id, "●")
        name = RESOURCE_NAMES.get(resource_id, resource_id)
        self.resource_lbl.setText(f"[{icon} {name}]")
        self.resource_lbl.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #4CAF50; border: none; "
            "font-weight: bold; font-style: normal;"
        )
        self.clear_btn.setVisible(True)
        self._apply_style()

    def clear_allocation(self):
        self._allocated_resource = None
        self.resource_lbl.setText("[—]")
        self.resource_lbl.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #666666; border: none; "
            "font-style: italic;"
        )
        self.clear_btn.setVisible(False)
        self._apply_style()

    def set_selected_border(self, selected: bool):
        """افزودن حاشیه‌ی نارنجی برای بخش انتخاب‌شده"""
        if selected:
            self.setStyleSheet("""
                QFrame#sectionCard {
                    background-color: rgba(26, 42, 74, 0.7);
                    border: 3px solid #FF8F00;
                    border-radius: 8px;
                }
            """)
        else:
            self._apply_style()

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def mousePressEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        if event.button() == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
            self.selected.emit(self.section_id)
        super().mousePressEvent(event)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def dragEnterEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        if event.mimeData().hasFormat(MIME_TYPE_RESOURCE):
            self._is_highlighted = True
            self._apply_style()
            event.acceptProposedAction()
        else:
            event.ignore()

    def dragLeaveEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        self._is_highlighted = False
        self._apply_style()

    def dropEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        self._is_highlighted = False
        self._apply_style()
        if event.mimeData().hasFormat(MIME_TYPE_RESOURCE):
            resource_id = bytes(
                event.mimeData().data(MIME_TYPE_RESOURCE)
            ).decode("utf-8")
            self.dropped.emit(self.section_id, resource_id)
            event.acceptProposedAction()
        else:
            event.ignore()

    def _on_clear_clicked(self):
        if self._allocated_resource is not None:
            self.cleared.emit(self.section_id)


# ====================================================================
# ویجت اصلی
# ====================================================================
